jobs.title: Physician (Specialty)
jobs.description:
About Us:

Arizona Liver Health (ALH) is dedicated to driving high standards of care and advancing medical innovation through leading clinical trials, ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance, and generating high-quality clinical data. Our network of multiphase, multitherapeutic research, standard of care, and VEN Centers sites is staffed by skilled providers, research, clinic, pharmacy, and patient outreach professionals. ALH operates state-of-the-art facilities and programs to meet the evolving needs of clinical research and overall patient treatment.

Job Summary:

The Physician  is a highly trained Specialist responsible for diagnosing, treating, and managing complex diseases and disorders affecting the liver. This role requires advanced knowledge of various organ systems and the ability to provide integrated care that focuses on the holistic well-being of patients who may suffer from multi-organ conditions.

Title: Physician (Specialty)

Status: Full-time, Exempt (Clinic Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm)

Salary: Depending on experience and qualifications

Location: Chandler, AZ (Onsite)

Essential job functions/duties

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Clinical Care and Diagnosis:

• Diagnose and treat diseases pertaining to the liver.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients’ health, including physical exams, laboratory tests, imaging studies, and other diagnostic tools.

• Develop and implement individualized treatment plans for patients with complex multi-system illnesses.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary medical teams to provide integrated care and improve patient outcomes.

• Provide ongoing monitoring of patients’ health and make adjustments to treatment plans as necessary.

• Stay updated on the latest medical research and advancements in the treatment of multi-organ diseases and contribute to clinical research.

• Educate patients and their families about their conditions, treatment options, and lifestyle adjustments.

• Participate in conferences, seminars, and other professional development activities to enhance expertise in the treatment of multi-organ diseases.

• Offer specialized consultation to other healthcare professionals dealing with complicated cases involving multiple organ systems.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities Required

• Extensive clinical experience in diagnosing and managing diseases that involve multiple organ systems.

• Mastery in interpreting complex diagnostic tests and using them for integrated treatment planning.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills for patient interaction and collaboration with internal medical teams.

• Ability to interpret complex data and make data-driven decisions to contribute to the advancement of medical knowledge.

• Proven experience in conducting clinical research and serving as a Primary Investigator for clinical trials highly preferred.

• Strong understanding of clinical trial methodologies, regulatory guidelines, as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP) strongly preferred.

• Leadership and mentorship experience within a healthcare setting is preferred.

• Experience in academic medicine or clinical research related to multi-organ diseases preferred.

• Knowledge of statistical analysis and data management for clinical trials is high preferred.

Supervisory responsibilities

• Ability and willingness to teach and train new and current team members including fellow physicians, APPs, and other medical personnel.

Education and/or credentials and trainings required

• Doctor of Medicine (MD, DO or equivalent) from a US accredited institution

• Board certification in specialty medicine such as: Hepatology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology, Surgical Care, Emergency Medicine, or other relevant specialties.

• Advanced fellowship or training in multi-organ diseases required

• Valid medical license and ability to practice in the state of Arizona

Benefits & Perks:

• Health, Dental, Vision (with HSA plans and employer contribution)

• 6 weeks PTO

• Continuing Medical Education budget (CME) and 5 days time off for CMEs

• 5 days Sick Time

• 7 Company Paid Holidays + 2 Paid Half-Days

• 401K with up to 6% company match (eligible to enroll after 90 days)

• Short & Long Term Disability

• Educational Assistance

Work authorization

• Must have valid documentation and authorization to work in the U.S. for any employer. Sponsorship or transfer of visa is not available

EEO statement

It is the policy of the Institute for Liver Health DBA Arizona Liver Health and Arizona Clinical Trials to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. This policy relates to all phases of employment, including, but not limited to, recruiting, employment, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, reduction of workforce and termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation, selection for training, the use of all facilities, and participation in all company-sponsored employee activities. Provisions in applicable laws providing for bona fide occupational qualifications, business necessity or age limitations will be adhered to by the company where appropriate.

Notice to Staffing Agencies: It is our policy that any and all contact with third party staffing or recruitment vendors come through our Talent Acquisition Team directly. We have an established and preferred network of contracted partners that we engage if and when we deem it necessary. We request that staffing agencies refrain from repeatedly contacting our hiring managers or employees directly. Unsolicited resumes, onsite solicitations, and inquiries will not be considered or responded to. Overly persistent or forceful inquires may also be blocked across our network at the domain level as spam. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Hardware Recruiter, Quality Control
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Job

As a Senior member of Anduril's Talent Acquisition team, you will own full-cycle hiring for our Quality Control and Inspection Engineering organizations as we continue to rapidly scale and grow. Your work will be hands-on and involve partnering closely with Quality and Manufacturing leadership to define hiring needs for highly technical, often hard-to-find inspection and quality talent, influence process improvements and efficiencies, and set a high bar of talent and performance. To achieve this, you will be given the autonomy and tools to execute, build, and develop Anduril's world-class Quality team. We are looking for someone who can handle every aspect of recruiting and talent mapping, excited to be part of a lean and nimble team on one mission together, where no task is too big or too small.

What You'll Do

• Own and drive hiring strategy full-cycle for Quality Control and Inspection roles, providing effective, clear communication and reporting

• Act as a subject matter expert in prospecting techniques and tools used for information retrieval, data extraction, web-scraping, continuous process improvement, process automation, and candidate management

• Conduct a high volume of interviews, demonstrating ability to anticipate and influence hiring manager preferences through successful interview-to-offer conversion ratios

• Engage and source passive candidates — quality inspectors, metrology technicians, and quality engineers — using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean strings, and referrals

• Build talent maps across the Quality Control, inspection, and metrology communities to generate market insights that inform your engagement strategy

• Drive diverse talent into the organization ensuring a positive candidate experience at every touchpoint

• Represent the company's brand and recruiting team internally and externally at the highest caliber

• Leverage internal resources, teammates, and cross-functional partners to build strategy around selling our value proposition and impacting hiring practices

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of full-cycle technical talent acquisition experience evaluating and hiring top-tier engineering and skilled-technical talent, including demonstrated experience recruiting Quality Control and Inspection professionals (e.g., incoming/in-process/final inspection, CMM/metrology, GD&T, MRB, FAI/AS9102, NCR/CAPA, SPC)

• 3+ years of experience working with senior-level leaders and stakeholders, reporting on progress, creating and advising on talent strategies

• Experience recruiting in a fast-paced in-house environment (agency background a plus), hiring Quality Control, Inspection, Quality Engineering, or adjacent disciplines (Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, or Mission Assurance)

• Ability to be onsite/hybrid at Costa Mesa, CA

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building a talent acquisition function from the ground up for a greenfield location

• Experience hiring into aerospace, defense, or other regulated/safety-critical industries, with working knowledge of ITAR policies around hiring practices

• Familiarity with the credentialing landscape for quality and inspection professionals (e.g., ASQ CQE, CQI, CQA, CQT; NDT Level II/III per NAS-410/SNT-TC-1A) and the quality standards that govern the work (AS9100, ISO 9001, NADCAP, MIL-STD inspection requirements)

• Familiarity with the trade schools, community colleges, apprenticeship programs, and employers that produce skilled inspection and metrology talent

• Experience acting in a consultative manner where your guidance has led to improved outcomes and positive candidate experiences

• Clear and effective communication with candidates to understand motivation, drivers, and fit within the organization

• Experience managing various high-volume pipelines of candidates and keeping track of their progress throughout the recruitment process

• Highly autonomous, collaborative, and adaptable

US Salary Range

$146,000—$180,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Monuments (Child Req to 1144)
jobs.description:
Summary

Creates complex design of VIP aircraft monuments, and mechanisms to meet customer criteria, quality standards, FAA requirements, budget and project schedules using Computer Aided Drafting/Design tools.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Designs complex monuments such as cabinets, bulkheads, vanities, lavatories, tables, divans, and other payload items.

• Designs complex mechanisms for tables, doors, drawers, divans and other moving features.

• Analyzes and interprets subsystem and project specifications.

• Selects materials for mechanical designs based on structural needs and materials specifications. Evaluates trade-offs in materials, hardness, composites, treatments, coatings, and other selections to best meet design objectives. Works with materials suppliers and material testing when needed.

• Applies experience and knowledge and works with Manufacturing Engineers to optimize designs for reduced parts counts, reduced manufacturing costs, reduced assembly error, and other factors affecting production cost and quality.

• Understands Bills of Materials, assembly concepts, fabrication specifications.

• Ensures designs meet customer criteria, quality standards and FAA requirements.

• Adheres to budget and project schedules.

• Provides design guidance and feedback to other engineering personnel.

• Maintains state-of-the-art knowledge in mechanical design practices, materials, components, and software design tools. Independently finds or creates solutions to problems requiring research, resourcefulness and creativity.

• Works with the Design Department to develop esthetic product designs that meet the market need and customer acceptance.

• Provides liaison engineering support.

• Supports test setups preparation and test reports development.

• Maintains regular attendance including being at work, being on time to work and working full shifts.

• Other duties as assigned.

Competencies:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

• Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications – Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, and keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability – Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative – Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

• Judgment – Displays willingness to make decisions, exhibits sound and accurate judgment, supports and explains reasoning for decisions, includes appropriate people in decision-making process, and makes timely decisions.

• Planning and Organization – Prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently, plans for additional resources, integrates changes smoothly, sets goals and objectives, and works in an organized manner.

• Job Knowledge – Competent in required job skills and knowledge, exhibits ability to learn and apply new skills, keeps abreast of current developments, requires minimal supervision, displays understanding of how job relates to others, and uses resources effectively.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in engineering, a minimum of 8 years relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Aviation background and aircraft interior experience required.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company, foreign government, foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong Computer Aided Drafting/Design skills, both 3D (Inventor preferred) and 2D (AutoCAD)

• Familiarity with industry standard practices, fasteners, materials, and component parts. As well as the ability to search and specify new supplied parts.

• Understanding of manufacturing methodologies, design-for-manufacturing and assembly, costing, and material selection.

• Knowledge of industry design, documentation, and drafting (ANSI Y14.5) standards.

• Understanding of mechanical motion modeling, and weight and balance analysis

• Ability to check engineering drawings for Fit, Form and Function.

• Ability to meet high expectations for meeting strict schedule, budget and technical solutions with minimal margin of error.

• Ability to adapt to tailored processes designed for prototype engineering (vs. production engineering)

• Broad and diverse knowledge of multiple disciplines: Mechanical: lower and upper attached structure, monuments, ceilings, side walls, flooring, placards, OEM modifications, etc. Avionics: Locating, provisioning, and installations for LRUs (electrical equipment). Ability to work independently and cross-functionally as part of an established and growing team. Strong communication and problem-solving skills. Strong time management and organizational skills. Ability to sit for extended periods of time, use hands to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and have close/color vision ability to adjust focus. Ability to travel as required. Ability to work outside of core business hours as required.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

• Big jobs and stretch assignments.

• High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.

• Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Onboarding and Activation
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Getting started on Gusto should feel effortless — the path from "I just signed up" to “my business is set up and running on Gusto” is where small business owners need us most, and where the biggest opportunity to grow the business lives. We're in the middle of the most exciting shift in Gusto's history: reimagining our product as a proactive AI teammate that doesn't just help small businesses, but does the work for them. Most of that opportunity is still ahead of us — which means this role is full of net-new, 0-to-1 problems to invent and build from the ground up. As a Staff Product Engineer on Growth Onboarding, you'll own the experience that turns curious signups into activated, thriving customers — taking friction out of getting started and meeting customers wherever they are, from the web to SMS, WhatsApp, and third-party AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude — working full-stack and cross-functionally as both a product builder and a founder.

About the Team:

Growth Onboarding owns one of the most consequential moments in a customer's journey: their first experience of Gusto. We're a full-stack, outcome-driven team measured by activation — not features shipped. We move fast, ship prototypes over docs, and partner tightly with Product, Design, Data, and other engineering teams to make onboarding simpler, smarter, and a launchpad for everything a business does next. You won't just be handed a roadmap — you'll help invent it, turning a bold AI product vision into new front doors and experiences that have never existed before. If you want your work to move a top-line number and shape the front door to a company serving 500,000+ businesses, this is the team.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Own meaningful slices of the signup-to-activation experience end to end — from data model to UI — and ship measurable improvements to how quickly and reliably new customers get up and running.

• Invent and prototype net-new, 0-to-1 experiences — bringing your own ideas for how AI can reimagine onboarding, not just implementing a spec handed to you.

• Partner directly with Product, Design, and Data to frame problems, form hypotheses, and validate them with real customers in weeks, not quarters.

• Identify where AI meaningfully removes customer effort (and where a simple form is better), and build those experiences thoughtfully into the flow.

• Design onboarding as modular, reusable building blocks so new entry points into Gusto can be added quickly without rebuilding the foundation.

• Raise the engineering bar through pragmatic technical direction, high-quality code, strong reviews, and mentoring engineers around you.

• Make sharp scoping calls under a time box — shipping the simplest version that proves or disproves an idea, then iterating.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping customer-facing products at scale.

• A product-minded engineer who starts from the customer problem and the metric that matters, not just the ticket — and who can operate independently across product, design, and data partners.

• Demonstrated ability to move fast and execute with high quality: someone who ships, measures, and iterates rather than waiting for perfect certainty.

• Experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to real product problems — with the judgment to know where it adds value and where it adds noise — and a habit of using AI tools to work more effectively.

• A founder mindset: high ownership, comfort with ambiguity and greenfield problems, and a bias toward action and outcomes over output.

• A track record of raising the bar for teams around you — through technical leadership, mentorship, and setting standards others follow.

• Strong full-stack fundamentals and the versatility to work wherever the problem is (front end, back end, data).

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $223,000/yr to $278,000/yr for San Francisco. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
Role: Patient Engagement Manager

Company: Atlas Oncology Partners

Location: Remote, 8am-5pm CST

Position Type: Full-Time

Salary: 75,000-100,000



About Us

Atlas is built for oncologists by oncologists. We provide practices with the staff, contracts, and tools they need to deliver whole-person care to their cancer patients. Our value-based approach to care delivery aligns incentives, offering patients better outcomes, payors guaranteed reduction in medical expense, and provider partners greater financial independence.

Role Description

As the Manager of Patient Engagement at Atlas Oncology Partners, you may be the first voice many patients hear, and you'll set the standard for everyone who follows you. This is a working manager role: roughly 80% hands-on telephonic outreach and 20% team leadership. You will carry your own outreach panel and enrollment targets while coaching a small team, building the playbook, and helping us scale patient engagement across new clinic sites. You will start with one direct report and are expected to help grow, hire, and onboard the team as Atlas expands. 

Above all, you're passionate about being a true partner to people living with cancer through every step of their care journey. You understand that a cancer diagnosis can be overwhelming, and you believe no one should have to navigate it alone. That belief shapes how you approach every conversation - and how you teach your team to approach theirs. Because Atlas is a startup, you are comfortable with change and ready to pivot quickly when priorities shift.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Patient Engagement (approximately 80%)

 - Utilize telephonic outreach and engagement strategies to contact patients and caregivers, explain Atlas services, and support enrollment into the Atlas program.

 - Effectively communicate Atlas services and address patient or caregiver concerns.

 - Represent Atlas professionally to patients, caregivers, and oncology partners.

 - Coordinate with the local outreach team to support telephonic outreach to engaged and non-engaged patients.

 - Leverage reports and dashboards to prioritize telephonic outreach to prospective patients.

 - Successfully meet and/or exceed individual monthly engagement targets.

 - Provide inbound call support for the clinic as needed, including routing calls to the appropriate team member.

 - Support other clinic administrative tasks as assigned, including referral routing and medical record-related tasks.

 - Serve as the escalation point for complex, sensitive, or at-risk patient conversations.

Team Leadership (approximately 20%)

 - Directly supervise the Patient Engagement team, beginning with one Patient Engagement Associate, and provide day-to-day direction, coaching, and support.

 - Own the team's enrollment and engagement targets; monitor performance against goals and intervene early when trends move in the wrong direction.

 - Conduct regular call reviews and one-on-ones to develop trust-building, objection-handling, and documentation skills.

 - Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training as the team grows across Atlas sites.

 - Build and maintain outreach scripts, call workflows, SOPs, and training materials; refine them based on what actually works on the phones.

 - Partner with Operations, Clinical, and site leadership to align outreach priorities with clinic capacity and scheduling.

 - Escalate operational barriers, data quality, dashboard gaps, staffing, telephony or CRM issues to the Operations Director with a recommended path forward.

Reporting

This role will report to the VP of Operations

Required Qualifications

 - Bachelors Degree in Healthcare Administration, Sales, or other relevant field preferred.

 - Minimum of 3-5 years of healthcare experience in care coordination, community health, patient engagement, customer service, or sales.

 - Prior experience as a team lead, supervisor, or senior/mentor-level individual contributor; formal people management experience preferred.

 - Proven success in a centralized contact center environment with a high volume of outbound communication preferred.

 - Comfort carrying a personal call volume and enrollment target alongside leadership responsibilities.

 - Strong aptitude for documentation; prior experience with a CRM platform is a plus.

 - Ability to read and act on performance reports and dashboards.

 - Excitement to be part of a tight-knit team with shared accountability for enrollment and strong collaboration skills.

 - Strong trust-building and communication skills; ability to effectively communicate Atlas services and address patient or caregiver concerns.

 - Impeccable customer service skills; willingness to go above and beyond for patients or caregivers.

 - Highly organized and efficient, with the judgment to prioritize independently in a startup environment.

 - Bilingual Spanish preferred.



Some of the benefits of our comprehensive benefits package include:

· Health, Dental, Vision insurance

· Competitive pay

· Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave



You will collaborate with like-minded health care professionals who, like you, understand the importance and value of Atlas’ high-quality, value-based care model.



Atlas is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristics.



Atlas is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants with a disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should email careers@atlasoncology.com for assistance. Reasonable accommodation will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hexium is modernizing Atomic Vapor Laser Isotope Separation (AVLIS), a laser-based isotope enrichment technology originally developed and demonstrated at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL). We are advancing AVLIS into a scalable, industrial-grade enrichment platform designed to strengthen domestic energy infrastructure, industrial resilience, and national security.

Role

We're hiring a Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead the translation of decades of AVLIS research and development into modern, manufacturable hardware. Initially based on-site at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) in Livermore, CA, you'll work through legacy technical records to identify the most relevant mechanical designs, reconstruct them as modern 3D assemblies, and identify gaps requiring further engineering. You'll collaborate with national laboratory scientists and engineers as needed to resolve technical questions and inform the modernized design.

From there, you'll advance designs through simulation, prototype hardware, and test fixtures, while serving as a mechanical design authority for Hexium's initial prototype and pilot systems. This is foundational engineering work that will bridge national laboratory R&D with the systems needed to advance AVLIS toward commercial application.

As the program progresses, this role will transition to a Hexium production facility and will require relocation.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and assess legacy AVLIS mechanical designs and technical records at a DOE national laboratory, working within required classified-handling procedures

• Own mechanical design of chamber and vacuum systems, including all system interfaces

• Apply vacuum system design to materials compatibility selection, outgassing mitigation, and contamination control

• Convert legacy designs into modern 3D CAD assemblies and validate them via thermal/structural simulation

• Work directly with national laboratory scientists and engineers to close technical design gaps

• Collaborate with Hexium's Integration Team on prototype procurement and testing requirements

• Qualify vacuum suppliers and custom equipment fabricators

• Define facility and utility interface requirements for prototype and pilot systems

• Partner with Nuclear Safety on design compliance

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of mechanical engineering experience, including vacuum system design and/or precision mechanical hardware

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or closely related field

• Proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo, or similar)

• Must currently hold an active DOE Q clearance or active DOD Top Secret clearance, or have held DOE Q / DOD Top Secret clearance within the past 18 months

• Must be a U.S. Person (required for access to export-controlled technical data)

• Willingness to work on-site full-time at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory initially, with required relocation to Hexium's production facility (location not yet determined) as the program progresses

Preferred Qualifications

Responsible for palletizing finished goods and ensuring the pallets are wrapped in a manner that maintains stability and neatness. Responsible for loading, unloading, and maintaining material to assigned machine units. jobs.title: Experienced Automotive Painter ($3,000 Hiring Bonus)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 5 years of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Painter, you’ll be expected to be highly skilled in painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule: Monday to Friday from 6:00am until 3:00pm with some over time availability including weekends

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

• Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths

• Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: VP Product & Design
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. 

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.




WHO WE ARE

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

Lead a high-performing Product and Design team to build what the future looks like with robots by our side, starting with sidewalk logistics. This role is accountable for raising the bar, identifying high-impact opportunities and big bets, and clearly articulating the rationale behind where we’re going and why.



This role partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Data, Business Development , Program Management, Safety, Policy, and other leaders to align priorities, navigate tradeoffs, and turn company strategy into clear, coordinated execution.




JOB DUTIES




LEAD A HIGH PERFORMING TEAM

 - Develop and uplevel a strong product management and design team and foster a culture for intellectual curiosity, measurable experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Set a high bar for product and design quality and craft and evolve how business opportunities, requirements, and validation are built, communicated, and maintained.

 - Serve as a key member of the leadership team and contribute beyond the Product organization to company-wide strategy and execution.

 - Establish clear roles, expectations, decision rights, and accountability across the organization.


PRODUCT VISION AND NARRATIVE

 - Deliver delight to customers and the public while expanding the sidewalk delivery business.

 - Translate corporate strategy and customer needs into clear product priorities and investment decisions for both product and design.

 - Develop a strong understanding of customers, users, competitors, and market dynamics to inform product direction and design principles..

 - Champion data-driven product decision making, using quantitative and qualitative insights to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide product strategy and investment.

 - Balance near-term customer and operational needs with investments in scalable, long-term product capabilities.

 - Ensure product development is grounded in real-world customer and user needs rather than technology development alone.

 - Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap that translates company strategy and customer needs into prioritized product initiatives, milestones, and outcomes.


DESIGN & USER EXPERIENCE

 - Lead the Design function and establish a cohesive design vision across the company's products and experiences.

 - Champion user-centered design and ensure customer and end-user insights are incorporated throughout the development process.

 - Build scalable design practices, systems, and standards that create intuitive and consistent experiences.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams to simplify complex technical capabilities into effective user experiences.

 - Ensure design is treated as a strategic product capability and incorporated early in product development.

 - Deliver on public safety-focused design from Industrial Design to Operational Tools
   
   



EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS



Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, design, or related technology leadership roles.

 - 5+ years of experience leading and developing product teams, including experience managing senior product leaders and/or multidisciplinary organizations.

 - Demonstrated experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex technology products from concept through commercialization and scale.

 - Proven track record of translating company strategy, customer needs, and technical capabilities into clear product priorities and measurable business outcomes.

 - Master communicator with experience partnering with executive leadership and communicating product, design and technical strategy to senior internal and external stakeholders.

 - Strong people leadership capabilities with demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.




Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

 - Experience developing products involving robotics, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, mobility, logistics, or other complex hardware and software systems.

 - Experience with products that operate in the physical world where safety, reliability, hardware constraints, operational performance, and user experience must be considered together.

 - Experience leading or directly overseeing both Product Management and Product Design organizations.

 - Experience developing B2B or B2B2C products involving enterprise customers, strategic partners, operators, and end consumers.

 - Experience building products that integrate hardware, software, data, operational tooling, and customer-facing experiences.

 - Experience developing products or platforms that support fleet operations, marketplaces, logistics, last-mile delivery, or other high-volume operational environments.

 - Experience scaling product organizations through periods of rapid company growth and changing business priorities.

 - Experience commercializing emerging technology and translating technically sophisticated capabilities into clear customer value.

 - Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, design, business, or a related field. Advanced degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Nearby AI Internship Program - Marketing & Operation Track
jobs.description:
About NewsBreak

Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About Nearby AI

Nearby AI is a new company from NewsBreak building a trust-first marketplace for local home services. We help homeowners understand a problem, what it should reasonably cost, and whether to hire at all before they are connected to a provider, and we help service providers win work on fit and outcomes rather than on speed of contact.

Our mission: give people clarity and control from the first sign of a problem to a job done right, and give good contractors work they are equipped to win.

We are a small founding team. We work from evidence, keep a written record of decisions, and hold a short set of product principles we do not trade for revenue: no pay-for-rank, no sharing of customer contact information beyond what the customer approved, and no quality claims we cannot substantiate.

The role

Nearby AI is a company being built from its first months. The work that matters most right now is done by phone, in spreadsheets, in draft copy, and in conversations with customers and service professionals. Founding Associates work directly with the founding team on the marketing and operational groundwork of a new marketplace, and are measured on what they get done.

There are two tracks. You choose a primary track when you apply, and strength on either one is what we are looking for. Every associate spends part of the program on the other track so the cohort learns both sides of the business.

Marketing track

• Creative and content experiments. Draft and test ad creative, landing-page copy, and content variants with the growth lead, under the company's plain-language and compliance standards. Read the results and write up what moved.

• Local content production. Help build the data-backed local pages and guides that form the company's organic channel: sourcing, structuring, and quality-checking content at the editorial gate.

• Organic and AI-search tracking. Track how the company's content is discovered and cited by search engines and AI assistants, and turn that into a weekly readout.

• Community and partnerships groundwork. Map local organizations, publications, and community groups in launch markets and prepare the outreach the brand launch will use.

Operations track

• Provider sourcing and verification. Identify, contact, and qualify service professionals in launch markets; verify credentials against public records; build the roster the product launches with.

• Customer research. Recruit and interview homeowners about how they make hiring decisions and what stops them; turn transcripts into findings the product and design teams act on.

• Market intelligence. Document the customer experience of incumbent services first-hand and produce evidence that informs positioning and compliance review.

• Pricing data. Gather and document real-world pricing by category and region, with sources, to seed the company's pricing benchmarks.

Qualifications

Required

• Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a rigorous undergraduate or graduate program, with a strong academic record.

• At least one initiative you started yourself, such as a club, business, research project, campaign, or publication, with results you can show.

• Strong written communication. A short writing sample is requested with your application.

• Comfortable with outbound work: calling strangers, running structured interviews, or pitching an idea to someone who did not ask for it.

• Working proficiency with spreadsheets and with AI tools as a daily working method.

Preferred, Marketing track

• Ran a campaign, newsletter, social account, or content project with an audience and measurable results.

• Coursework or experience in marketing, communications, journalism, or SEO.

Preferred, Operations track

• Prior work in construction, real estate, or home services, including family businesses.

• Coursework or experience in economics, statistics, or research methods.

Preferred, either track

• Prior internship or work at an early-stage company.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Pay may vary based on a number of factors including job-related skills, level, experience, geographic location and relevant education or training. At NewsBreak, we design our overall rewards package to attract top talents. Depending on the position, the role may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and options. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Annual Base Pay Range

$30—$60 USD

jobs.title: Director of TPM
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s centralized, global TPM organization helps Engineering deliver the company’s most complex and consequential technical, product, and business transformations. The team spans DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo and partners across a global Engineering organization of approximately 4,000 engineers.

We have intentionally built a lean, high-leverage TPM organization with a high bar for technical depth, business judgment, and independent domain ownership. Our leaders stay close to the business and technical work, lead through strong senior IC TPMs, and shape the operating mechanisms that allow complex organizations to execute at speed.

This Director will lead 12 TPMs (one-quarter of the global TPM organization) and report directly to the VP of Engineering Operations. Their team supports nearly 1,300 engineers across five strategically important organizations: Dasher & Logistics, Ads & Promotions, Merchant, DashOS, and Platform Services.

About the Role

As Director of Technical Program Management, you will lead a high-performing team of TPMs embedded across some of DoorDash’s most important and technically complex businesses. Your portfolio spans the real-time fulfillment network that powers every delivery, a multi-billion dollar ads revenue platform, DoorDash’s merchant ecosystem and in-store technology, and platforms that enable merchants and other businesses to access our logistics network through offerings such as Drive and Parcels.

You will partner closely with a VP and four Senior Directors to set direction, strengthen execution, develop TPM talent, and solve the cross-organizational challenges that sit between teams, systems, and business priorities. You will also play a central role in Pedregal, DoorDash’s multi-year global platform re-architecture across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo while maintaining production availability and continuing to build for each business’ evolving requirements.

We believe the future of TPM leadership is defined by leverage, not layers. This role is for a forward-looking leader who can develop an intentionally lean, high-performing team, use AI to amplify its impact, and shape strategy and organizational capability while remaining meaningfully connected to the work.

You must be located near San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA, or Seattle, WA for this hybrid position.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead and develop 12 TPMs supporting nearly 1,300 engineers across five strategic engineering organizations.

• Partner with senior Engineering and Product leaders to shape portfolio strategy, investment tradeoffs, technical sequencing, risk management, and organizational operating models.

• Help scale DoorDash’s core delivery network; accelerate the next several billion dollars of Ads growth; build the merchant operating system; and expand access to DoorDash logistics through Drive and Parcels.

• Establish durable mechanisms for execution, technical readiness, decision-making, and cross-functional alignment across highly interdependent organizations.

• Develop exceptional TPM talent and create an environment where senior ICs can own broad, strategic scope and serve as trusted partners to Engineering leadership.

• Help define the next evolution of a modern TPM organization, identifying the strategic initiatives, technical transformations, and organizational capabilities where AI-enabled ways of working can increase the pace and quality of execution.

We’re excited about you because you have…

• 12+ years of TPM experience, including 7+ years leading TPM teams. You have demonstrated success leading a team that supports a broad, complex technical portfolio in a high-growth technology company.

• Deep commitment to developing talent and building culture within your team, setting a high bar for technical depth, ownership, sound judgment, and independent execution. You hire, coach, and promote strong TPMs who are technical leaders, focus on outcomes over process, and consistently deliver business value while improving engineering efficiency and collaboration.

• The technical and business judgment to identify and align your team to the highest-impact opportunities as well as make thoughtful investment and sequencing tradeoffs.

• The technical credibility to engage with Engineering leaders on architecture, platform migrations, system dependencies, reliability, and risk, while translating that complexity into clear decisions and execution plans.

• A track record of leading large-scale, multi-year transformations that require alignment across multiple organizations, systems, products, and stakeholders.

• A strategic mindset that shapes how engineering delivers. You consistently identify and resolve ambiguous business, technical, operational, and organizational issues. You also build these capabilities in your team and your stakeholders.

• An instinct for building durable operating mechanisms rather than relying on personal heroics: clear ownership, decision forums, execution cadences, risk management, and accountability.

• Exceptional communication and influence skills. You build trust with your TPM peers and with senior engineering leaders, surface difficult issues directly, create clarity in ambiguity, and align teams around shared outcomes.

• Curiosity and practical fluency with AI-enabled ways of working, with a point of view on how technology can improve execution and unlock new strategic possibilities.

• Experience operating effectively with globally distributed teams and across different organizational cultures, time zones, and business contexts.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Fintech (Santo Domingo)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRUELOGIC

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.




OUR CLIENT

This leading home equity platform offers an alternative to traditional financing through its flagship product, the Home Equity Investment (HEI). An HEI allows homeowners to access their home equity to clear debt, navigate financial challenges, and diversify wealth without increasing monthly payments, while giving investors access to owner-occupied residential real estate.



JOB SUMMARY

This leading home equity platform is seeking its first Forward Deployed Engineer to establish a new capability focused on identifying, designing, and implementing automation solutions across complex product and operational workflows.

Sitting within DevOps but operating horizontally across the company, the role collaborates closely with Process Improvement teams and Product Owners. The position addresses workflows involving multiple systems, manual handoffs, and operational dependencies to determine how technology can optimize them. Rather than handling traditional ticket-driven engineering, this role takes ambiguous business problems, analyzes current processes, designs technical interventions, and owns implementation end-to-end.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner with Process Improvement, Product, DevOps, IT, Security, and other business functions to identify and understand workflow and process problems.

 - Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete technical approaches.

 - Map existing workflows, including systems, stakeholders, handoffs, dependencies, and bottlenecks.

jobs.title: Compliance Associate - Bank Sponsorship & Product Expansion
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.




OUR ETHOS

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.



The Role

We are hiring a Compliance Associate to support our bank sponsorship relationships and the compliance workstreams behind new product and market expansion. You will sit at the center of Product, Engineering, Legal, and our sponsor banks: translating partnership agreements and regulatory requirements into concrete product requirements, preparing the documentation our bank partners rely on, and helping launches move quickly without compromising on compliance.

This is a high-visibility, execution-heavy role for someone equally comfortable reading a bank partnership agreement and sitting in a product spec review. You will see products from concept through launch and own the compliance record that makes each launch defensible.



What You'll Do

•     Serve as a day-to-day compliance point of contact for sponsor bank partners — responding to diligence requests, preparing materials, and tracking open items to closure.

•     Review new products, features, and market expansions for compliance impact, and translate applicable regulations and bank partner requirements into clear, actionable product requirements.

•     Build and maintain compliance documentation: requirement matrices, policies and procedures, launch checklists, control descriptions, and risk assessments.

•     Read and interpret bank partnership agreements, network rules, and regulatory guidance, and flag where product designs create obligations or gaps.

•     Partner with Product and Engineering from the start of the design process so compliance requirements are built in rather than retrofitted.

•     Support disclosure, marketing, and UX reviews for accuracy and consistency with consumer protection expectations (UDAAP, Reg E, Reg Z, Reg CC).

•     Support bank partner oversight activities, audits, exams, and third-party risk assessments — including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and follow-up.

•     Monitor regulatory and network developments relevant to card issuing, BaaS, and stablecoin-linked payments, and summarize the practical implications for the business.

•     Track compliance deliverables and deadlines across multiple concurrent launches and stakeholders, escalating risks early and clearly.



What We’re Looking For

•     4+ years experience in compliance, risk, or regulatory roles within banking, fintech, or payments.

•     Working knowledge of the bank sponsorship / Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) model and third-party risk management expectations.

•     Familiarity with core consumer financial regulations (e.g., BSA/AML, UDAAP, Reg E, Reg Z, Reg CC, EFTA, GLBA).

•     Ability to read and interpret bank partnership agreements, regulatory guidance, and compliance requirements, and translate them into clear, actionable product requirements.

•     Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and bank partners.

•     Excellent written communication skills, including experience creating compliance documentation (requirement matrices, policies, checklists).

•     Detail-oriented with strong project management and organizational skills; comfortable tracking multiple deliverables and deadlines across stakeholders.

•     Analytical mindset with the ability to assess compliance risk and prioritize issues.



Bonus Attributes

•     Prior experience working directly with a sponsor bank or bank partnership team.

•     Experience at a fintech, neobank, or payments company.

•     Familiarity with product and project management tools.

•     Professional certification such as CRCM (Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager), CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), or similar.

•     Experience supporting bank exams, audits, or third-party risk assessments.

•     Exposure to stablecoins, digital assets, or cross-border payments.




THINGS THAT ENABLE A FULFILLING, HEALTHY AND HAPPY EXPERIENCE AT RAIN:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

jobs.title: Technical Success Engineer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.

As a Technical Success Engineer, you'll serve as the first line of contact for questions coming through our support queue, investigating bugs, escalating when needed, and staying with each issue until it's resolved. You'll partner with Customer Success to ensure successful technical implementation for customers, and keep DataGrail's public documentation up to date. You'll also see firsthand what blocks customers in the product, and you'll partner regularly with Product and Engineering to help shape upcoming features. DataGrail is an AI-first organization, and you'll use tools like Claude and Claude Code every day to work more efficiently, right alongside the rest of the team.

What You'll Do:

• Serve as DataGrail's tier 1 technical support, resolving requests directly and flagging what needs deeper expertise.

• Investigate and reproduce reported bugs, then escalate to Engineering with clear repro steps and context.

• Facilitate the back-and-forth between Engineering and the customer, and close the loop once a fix or workaround ships.

• Partner with Customer Success to ensure successful technical implementation for customers.

• Keep DataGrail's public documentation up to date.

• Identify recurring patterns in support tickets to help improve processes and documentation, enabling customers to self-serve enablement and troubleshooting as much as possible, and helping drive down resolution time and key SLAs.

• Contribute to DataGrail's AI-first workflows, helping build and improve the shared tools, prompts, and processes that help the team move faster.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering, surfacing what's blocking customers in the product and feeding that insight into upcoming features.

What You'll Bring:

• Strong technical background from an engineering, technical support, or implementation role.

• Familiarity with at least one programming language, ideally Ruby on Rails, with the ability to write scripts to diagnose issues.

• Ability to reproduce an issue, gather technical context from a non-technical customer, and dig through logs to paint a complete picture for Engineering.

• Strong written communicator, comfortable working directly with customers via email or Zoom, able to translate technical issues into clear guidance for both customers and engineers.

• Comfortable being pulled in multiple directions at once, able to multitask and shift between competing high-priority issues throughout the day.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity, asking good questions, and experimenting with new approaches as the support function matures.

• An AI-first mindset: you use tools like Claude and Claude Code daily and contribute to the shared AI workflows and processes that help the whole team move faster.

• A habit of flagging process or tooling improvements when you spot a recurring problem.

Bonus Points

• Experience with REST APIs and authentication protocols such as SAML and SSO.

• Experience with logging and observability tools such as Datadog or Sentry.

• Familiarity with AWS or cloud infrastructure basics.

• Familiarity with SQL and analytics.

What Success Looks Like:

Within 90 Days You'll:

• Be fully ramped on DataGrail's product and support workflows, responding to tickets independently.

• Be able to independently handle day-to-day technical support requests, and know when and how to loop in others for the more complex ones.

• Successfully investigate a bug, raise it with Engineering with clear repro steps, and close the loop with the customer.

• Make your first contributions to DataGrail's public documentation.

Within 180 Days You'll:

• Own front-line technical support end-to-end for all the requests that come your way.

• Contribute regularly to DataGrail's public documentation, both writing new content and reviewing existing pages.

• Be a reliable partner to Customer Success on customer technical implementation.

• Start spotting recurring patterns in tickets and sharing early ideas for improving processes and reducing resolution time.

Within 365 Days You'll:

• Be a go-to resource for technical support questions.

• Help drive down resolution time and consistently meet strong SLA targets, including time to first response.

• Take ownership of reducing the volume of issues escalated to Engineering, closing gaps in documentation, tooling, and support-level fixes.

• Stay closely attuned to patterns and pain points across support, proactively raising product gaps as feature requests, and closing documentation gaps yourself rather than just flagging them.

Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state.

All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change.

Compensation Range

$80,000—$100,000 USD

About Us:

DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales.

Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC.
