jobs.title: Research Associate (Product Development)
jobs.description:
Fortera is transforming one of the world’s largest industries by reinventing how cement is made. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Fortera has developed next-generation cement technology that delivers high performance while reducing CO₂ emissions by up to ~70%. By mineralizing CO₂ and turning it into a productive feedstock, Fortera converts emissions into a valuable building material, creating a more sustainable path for modern construction.

With our commercial ReCarb® plant operating in Redding, California, and a growing global project pipeline, Fortera is moving from first-of-a-kind deployment to scaled commercialization. Our technology is already being used in real-world infrastructure applications, bringing next-generation cement into use today while expanding toward broader adoption.

At Fortera, you’ll work alongside scientists, engineers, operators, and industry experts who are turning cutting-edge materials science into real-world impact. We’re looking for curious thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who want to help tackle one of the biggest challenges facing our planet.

This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

Build What’s Next.

Visit www.forteraglobal.com to learn more.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Research Associate will support laboratory research and product development efforts focused on lower-carbon cement and concrete products. This role will prepare and evaluate cement-based materials, perform standardized and novel testing, assist with experimental design, and analyze and communicate research findings. As experience is gained, the Research Associate may independently plan and lead defined experimental projects.

This position is part of the Product team within Fortera’s Research and Development department.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Prepare cement-based paste, mortar, and concrete mixtures and evaluate their performance.

• Perform standardized mortar and concrete testing in accordance with ASTM and other applicable testing standards.

• Conduct novel product and performance testing to support research and product development.

• Perform experiments under the guidance of scientists and contribute to experimental planning.

• Accurately collect, organize, analyze, and interpret experimental data.

• Use research findings to support product and process improvements.

• Operate analytical and materials characterization equipment, such as SEM, XRD, and TGA, as needed.

• Document experimental procedures and results and present findings during research meetings.

• Maintain laboratory supplies, consumables, chemicals, equipment, and inventory records.

• Conduct routine safety inspections and support a clean and organized laboratory environment.

• Follow all laboratory safety procedures and lean practices.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 2+ years of professional/industry laboratory experience in R&D or testing.

• Experience working safely in a laboratory environment with chemicals and laboratory equipment.

• Ability to follow experimental procedures and perform testing consistently and repeatably.

• Strong attention to detail and demonstrated scientific problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

• Ability to accurately document, organize, and communicate experimental findings.

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

• Willingness to learn new testing methods, equipment, and technical concepts.

• Strong interest in developing a career in research and product development.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience with standardized mortar or concrete testing, including ASTM C109, C187, C191, C305, C143, C39, C78, and/or AC529.

• Experience with concrete durability testing.

• Experience operating analytical or materials characterization equipment, such as SEM, XRD, and TGA, and interpreting the resulting data.

• Relevant cement or concrete certifications, such as ACI certification, Cement Physical Tester certification, or field or laboratory concrete testing credentials.

• Experience with concrete field operations, manufacturing, batching, or mix design.

• Experience with lower-carbon cement, alternative cementitious materials, or carbon capture, utilization, and storage technologies.

• Experience working in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

COMPENSATION:

The compensation package for this role includes a competitive base salary commensurate with experience of $72,000 - $80,000  as well as an annual bonus and pre-IPO incentive stock options.

PERKS AND BENEFITS:

We know that happy employees are productive employees, which is why we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• 100% company-funded Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability coverages for employees

• Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• Tax deferred & Roth 401k

• Paid vacation days (increased with tenure), 12 paid holidays, and unlimited PTO for exempt employees

Fortera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law. Diverse candidates are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, DevOps and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
About Point

✨ Real Impact, Real People: Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

✨ Funding: With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we’re scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

✨ Game-changing Product: We're building a category defining company in home equity. We’ve earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

✨ Great Place to Work: Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection: Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture.

Location

This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, with team members expected to work onsite one day per week for in-person collaboration.

About the role

Point is standing up a new AI Enablement function, and this dual-mandate leader will own it alongside our DevOps and platform practice. You will run the reliability, delivery, and cloud foundations a lending business depends on, while building the central hub that partners with our corporate functions (HR, Legal, Compliance, Accounting, Finance) and our Operations team (underwriters, processors, closers) to automate and augment their work with AI. Working in close partnership with IT and Security, you will set the technical direction, drive adoption, and define what success looks like across both mandates. It is a rare opportunity to shape how an entire company applies AI to its everyday work, from the platform up.

Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team!

Your responsibilities

• Lead the infrastructure platform and shared-services organization, and drive key initiatives across the SRE and infrastructure functions.

• Own reliability, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), release tooling, and observability, including incident management and security and compliance (SOC 2).

• Stand up and run AI Enablement as the central hub: the sanctioned platform, guardrails, reusable components, and the harder builds.

• Partner with corporate functions and Operations to identify high-value workflows and design agentic AI solutions (LLM-based agents, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and n8n / Zapier / custom integrations).

• Partner closely with IT and Security to keep enablement safe and compliant, including sanctioned tooling, access, and data-handling boundaries for sensitive and regulated functions.

• Drive adoption of what the team ships: define success metrics, baseline before building, and measure impact such as capacity reclaimed, cycle time, cost per loan, and stickiness.

• Define multi-quarter roadmaps tied to measurable business outcomes.

• Stay current on AI and automation advances, and pivot the roadmap based on user feedback and new technical capabilities.

• Set technical and quality standards through architecture guidance and review.

About you

• 10+ years in DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, with strong technical depth.

• 3+ years leading and growing engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.

• Demonstrated experience shipping AI automations to production, including LLM agents, tool calling, RAG, and workflow orchestration.

• A track record of tying automation or platform work to quantifiable business outcomes.

• Production proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Strong observability and incident-management practice (Grafana, Datadog/NewRelic, or PagerDuty).

• Technical fluency to guide and review engineering and automation work (for example Python or equivalent).

• Excellent cross-functional communication, and the ability to earn trust with non-engineering stakeholders such as Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations.

Nice to have

• Built a new function or team from zero in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment.

• Fintech or other regulated-industry experience, and familiarity with PII handling and SOC 2.

• Process-improvement or RPA partnership experience.

• Lending or mortgage operations domain knowledge.

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area | $269,800 - $298,200

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

Our benefits

• Generous health benefits: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).

• Unlimited paid time off: Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.

• Flexible remote and onsite work: Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.

In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.

• Equity: We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success.

• Financial wellness: We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.

• Extra work/life benefits: We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor.

We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. jobs.title: Robotics Engineer (New Grad): Government Projects
jobs.description:
Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.



As a Robotics Engineer (New Grad): Government Projects, you'll work at the boundary of software and hardware: helping stand up new robotic manufacturing cells, configuring GMR-AI to generate the toolpaths that make a new application work, and getting hands-on with the tooling and controls of the system.



Responsibilities

 - Support proof-of-concept work that demonstrates what GMR's robotic systems can do for a new application or customer

 - Learn the manufacturing processes, requirements, and constraints for each project, and help gather the data (measurements, CAD, documentation) that shapes a new robotic cell

 - Assist in robotic manufacturing cell design, working alongside software and mechatronics engineers to reason about reachability, cycle time, and efficiency

 - Help design, build, and test custom end-of-arm tooling and work-holding fixtures, from early concept through validation

 - Configure GMR-AI to generate toolpaths and trajectories for new applications, with guidance from senior engineers

 - Help test and prototype new inspection sensors and tools, including hands-on evaluation of emerging vendor technology

 - Install, troubleshoot, and maintain controls components: sensors, PCs, and third-party device controllers

 - Contribute to new process recipes as GMR's systems take on different materials and geometries

 - Partner with GMR software engineers to prototype new ideas and methods, building toward taking on more of this independently

 - Rotate across process engineering, mechanical/tooling, and software workstreams early on, to build the same full-stack fluency senior engineers on this team rely on

 - Travel to project sites as needed to support installs, proof-of-concepts, or on-site troubleshooting



Export Control Requirements

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.



Minimum Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree (or in-progress remotely/completed Master's) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline

 - Hands-on experience with physical robotic or mechanical systems through coursework, internships, co-ops, capstone projects, or research (0-2 years total experience expected)

 - Demonstrated ability to follow and execute a structured experiment or process with high attention to detail

 - Working familiarity with basic scripting and data analysis (Python or similar)

 - Strong written communication skills; comfortable documenting technical findings and procedures clearly

 - Excellent analytical skills and genuine curiosity to understand how and why a process works

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to Design of Experiments (DOE) methodology or statistical process analysis

 - Coursework or project experience with ROS/ROS2

 - Experience with point cloud, force, or other 3D sensor data

 - Experience with 6DOF robot arms

 - CAD experience (SolidWorks or similar) or hands-on manufacturing/shop experience

• Represent utilities’ interests with marketing, product, and executive teams, influencing our go-to-market strategy.

• Travel up to 30% of the time

Required:

• Discipline in CRM use, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting

• Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills, both in-person and virtually

• Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and evolving work environment

Strongly Preferred:

• Experience selling analytics or market data subscriptions, as opposed to transactional or project-based products

• Familiarity with an established sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Challenger

Additional Details

This full-time position is based in LevelTen Energy’s Seattle office or remote. Salary and incentives commensurate with experience.

• This position is preferably based in the Seattle area (3 days per week in office/hybrid) Remote candidates with the right experience are also welcome.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.

Our virtual cards protect 250,000+ users across the U.S., processing over $3 billion in transactions with bank-level security and encryption. From merchant-locked cards that can't be used anywhere else if stolen, to spending limits that block unauthorized charges, to one-click pausing that stops subscriptions instantly, Privacy puts financial control back in users' hands.

We're building a future where every online payment is secure by default, free from data breaches, unauthorized charges, and hidden fees. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' "Top 100 Most Customer-Centric Companies" and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, and Wirecutter.

Privacy is the product that started it all. What began as Privacy.com grew into Lithic, now a Series C company backed by world-class investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. Our dedicated team of 35 sits at the heart of Lithic's 170+ person organization, spanning 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers.

What You’ll Do

• Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface

• Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now

• Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy

• Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review

• Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding

• Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target

• Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions

• Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in

• Lead the team and work cross-functionally

• Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap

• Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you

• Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar

What You’ll Bring

• Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you

• Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one

• Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L

• Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences

• Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output

• Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly

• Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement

• Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble

The annual US salary range for this role is $168,000 - $225,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

• 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Lifecycle & Messaging Platform
jobs.description:
About NewsBreak

Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About Nearby AI

Nearby AI is a new company from NewsBreak building a trust-first marketplace for local home services. We help homeowners understand a problem, what it should reasonably cost, and whether to hire at all before they are connected to a provider, and we help service providers win work on fit and outcomes rather than on speed of contact.

Our mission: give people clarity and control from the first sign of a problem to a job done right, and give good contractors work they are equipped to win.

We are a small founding team. We work from evidence, keep a written record of decisions, and hold a short set of product principles we do not trade for revenue: no pay-for-rank, no sharing of customer contact information beyond what the customer approved, and no quality claims we cannot substantiate.

The problem you will own

In a two-sided marketplace, nearly every commitment made to a customer or a provider is delivered as a message: confirmations, time-sensitive notifications to professionals, outcome follow-ups that feed our quality measurement, shared summaries for family members, and longer-horizon engagement. Because consumer messaging in our category is regulated, the platform that sends these messages is also the system that enforces consent, preferences, and suppression. You will design, build, and own that platform across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels.

Responsibilities

• Design and build the messaging platform: triggering, routing, templating, retries, deduplication, rate limiting, scheduling, and delivery tracking, with reliability and observability as first-class requirements.

• Build the consent and preference layer: per-channel consent records with provenance, opt-out and do-not-contact propagation to partners within contracted timelines, quiet hours, and suppression rules that no campaign can override.

• Own deliverability end to end: sender registration and reputation, authentication standards, bounce and complaint handling.

• Partner with data and machine-learning engineers on event-triggered engagement, including frequency management and holdout design.

• Provide experimentation hooks so growth can test timing, content, and channel without changes to the core platform.

• Establish engineering standards for a system that carries regulatory obligations, including audit trails and access controls.

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of backend software engineering, including ownership of a messaging, notification, or lifecycle platform.

• Operated that platform at meaningful scale, millions of messages per month, across at least two of email, SMS, and push.

• Designed event-driven systems with explicit idempotency, retry, and deduplication guarantees, and carried on-call responsibility for them.

• Shipped within a consent or privacy regime such as TCPA, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, or CCPA, where the system, not a policy document, enforced the rules.

• Hands-on production experience with a major messaging provider or platform (for example Twilio, SendGrid, Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or an in-house equivalent), and clear judgment about build versus buy.

• Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript, plus SQL.

Preferred

• Lifecycle or growth engineering on a large consumer product.

• Integrations with CRMs, call centers, or partner systems through webhook or real-time APIs.

• Deliverability troubleshooting at scale, including sender registration and domain reputation recovery.

• Experience building experimentation infrastructure.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Pay may vary based on a number of factors including job-related skills, level, experience, geographic location and relevant education or training. At NewsBreak, we design our overall rewards package to attract top talents. Depending on the position, the role may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and options. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Annual Base Pay Range

$150,000—$280,000 USD

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Liaison (Full-Time, Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to dramatically expand access to healthcare by reimagining the patient experience—delivered at home and powered by technology for scale.

We’re building the technology and clinical services platform to make preventive, connected healthcare accessible for everyone in the US. We deliver hybrid care (in-home + virtual) backed by data products across 15+ states, serving 60%+ of the US population through major health plans and systems. With 1M+ patients and 92+ NPS, we’re rapidly scaling our impact. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators is backed by investors including a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel.

We have a rapidly growing team of visionary leaders who are passionate about increasing access to care, lowering healthcare costs, and improving outcomes for patients.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are growing rapidly and are looking for a Clinical Operations Liaison to support our clinical leaders as we scale our field operations and clinical teams. You’ll be the connective thread between our NPs and Sprinters (our clinician field staff) and the operational systems that keep them paid, trained, and compliant — handling workforce tracking, payroll compliance follow-up, documentation review, and reporting so clinical leadership can stay focused on patient care, clinical support, and clinical oversight.

We’re not just looking for someone to execute a checklist. As we scale, we want someone who notices where a workflow is clunky, a tracker is out of date, or a process could run smoother — and speaks up about it. You’ll have real opportunities to help shape how these processes evolve.



This is a remote full-time position. This role reports to the Director of Quality & Training.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


WORKFORCE & PAYROLL COMPLIANCE

 - Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for NPs and Sprinters on timesheet, mileage, and documentation questions

 - Follow up with field employees on timesheet submissions, PTO entries and approval, and sick time to ensure accuracy before each payroll close

 - Validate weekly mileage and hours are submitted in accordance with policy and protocols

 - Review and abstract supporting documentation for mileage and time submissions

ESCALATION & PROGRAM SUPPORT

 - Manage administrative escalation trackers and ensure timely follow-up on open items

 - Route non-clinical operational issues to appropriate teams

 - Track project milestones and action items; support new workflow launches as directed by the In-Home Director


COMPLIANCE & QUALITY

 - Participate in internal audits; identify documentation gaps and recommend process improvements

 - Flag recurring issues or inefficiencies in existing workflows and propose fixes to your manager

 - Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and compliance standards


YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF

 - You take pride in accuracy and integrity, finding satisfaction in getting every detail right

 - You’re motivated by mission as much as metrics — knowing your work directly supports better access to preventive and chronic care for patients nationwide

 - You thrive in a tech-forward, fast-growing environment where innovation and continuous improvement are part of the daily rhythm

 - You’re naturally curious, proactive, and eager to contribute feedback and shape evolving processes

 - Most of all, you value flexibility, accountability, and being part of a company that’s reimagining how healthcare reaches people where they are


ABOUT YOU

 - Excitement for working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Preferred:

THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE

jobs.title: Associate Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Associate Applied Scientist, you’ll be embedded in the Applied Science team. Our members rely on us to answer hard questions — Which doctor should I see? What will it cost? When should we reach out, and how? — and the quality of those answers is determined by the algorithms behind them.

This is not a dashboards or descriptive-analytics role. You will own production systems end-to-end: framing the problem, defining the objective function, choosing the right approach (ML, optimization, heuristics, expert systems, or a hybrid), shipping it, and improving it against real-world outcomes. The closest analog outside healthcare is a quantitative researcher at a top hedge fund.

What you will do

• Ship production algorithmic systems end-to-end, from problem framing to launch to iteration

• Frame messy, real-world healthcare and business constraints into clear objectives, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks

• Define the set of metrics needed to judge whether a solution is working, and validate solutions before they ship

• Choose the right approach for each problem, from machine learning to optimization to heuristics to simple rules, based on what the problem actually calls for

• Bring new ideas to your work, experimenting with approaches beyond the obvious to get better results

• Produce rigorous, well-validated work others can rely on, and review your peers' code and analyses

• Build a deep understanding of the healthcare economy and Garner's place in it

To make the role concrete, here are two problems on our near-term roadmap:

• Provider tiering optimization. Build a tiering algorithm that jointly optimizes geographic access and total-cost-of-care savings across our doctor network. The objective function, constraints, and tradeoff surface are all open design questions.

• Member engagement model. Build an ML system that ingests claims data and in-app behavior to choose the right channel and moment for each touchpoint — SMS, push, phone, or email — to influence member behavior toward better-quality, lower-cost care.

What we're looking for

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree (in progress) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related STEM field, with an expected graduation date of Fall 2026 or Spring 2027.

• A bias toward action, quickly translating ideas into working prototypes to test approaches.

• Strong applied problem-solving skills, with the ability to define good metrics and then deliver solutions that improve them.

• A solid command of the methods your work calls for and the data your models depend on.

• Strong judgment in choosing between statistical models, heuristics, optimization approaches, and simpler algorithmic methods depending on the problem.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present your work clearly to senior stakeholders.

• A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

What you’ll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Technologies we use

• Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake, pandas, XGBoost, PyTorch, HuggingFace, modern LLM tooling and eval frameworks. We pick tools based on the problem, not the resume — bring your judgment.

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation

The target base comp range for this role is $150,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.

Fraud and Security Notice:

Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use getgarner.com and garnerhealth.com email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@garnerhealth.com.

jobs.title: Remote Clinical Psychologist - Texas
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

We're hiring a licensed clinical psychologist (PhD/PsyD) to conduct autism diagnostic evaluations for Adults, Teens, and Children via telehealth — as our founding diagnostician, building the function from zero.

Families across the country wait months for an autism evaluation, and nothing starts until that evaluation is done. Finni Health already delivers ABA therapy to kiddos across the country; diagnostics is how we close the gap between "something's going on" and "care has started." You'll be the clinician who builds it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

FLEXIBLE, REMOTE-FIRST WORK

COMPENSATION

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Head of Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is seeking a proven, senior demand generation leader to own the full pipeline engine from always-on digital programs to brand and thought leadership amplification, digital events, and sales development. The right candidate brings a track record of building integrated, data-driven marketing motions in fast-growing B2B SaaS companies and can operate at both the strategic and executional levels.

You will report to the VP of Revenue Marketing and serve as a key GTM partner to Sales, RevOps, and Marketing leadership. This role carries direct accountability for the marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline across new-logo and expansion efforts.

What would you do if hired?

Always-On Demand Generation

• Drive MQL-to-SQL conversion through full-funnel campaign architecture; from top-of-funnel awareness to qualified pipeline handoff

• Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to ensure clean attribution, lead routing, and funnel reporting in HubSpot and Salesforce

• Manage paid media budgets with a rigorous test-and-optimize cadence; own program ROI and CAC reporting

• Develop programs in partnership with ABX Campaign Architecture to drive account engagement and pipeline acceleration for target ICP accounts

Content Strategy & Thought Leadership Promotion

• Lead content distribution strategy across owned, earned, and paid channels ensuring thought leadership assets (research reports, Gartner MQ, analyst content) are activated across every demand motion

• Collaborate with Product Marketing and Content teams to develop demand-generating content: webinars, whitepapers, case studies, solution briefs, and digital content sequences

• Drive awareness and new logo pipeline through brand amplification programs, including employee advocacy, partner co-marketing, and executive visibility

• Leverage editorial and content calendars to maintain consistent, campaign-integrated messaging across all channels

Digital Human & Webinar Programs

• Own the webinar program end-to-end: strategy, topic selection, promotion, speaker coordination, production, and post-event lead nurture

• Expand digital event programming including virtual summits, customer spotlights, and co-hosted partner webinars

• Explore and pilot emerging digital human / AI avatar capabilities to scale thought leadership content delivery and engagement

SDR & AI SDR Leadership

• Manage and develop the SDR team (and AI SDR platform, if applicable), setting quota frameworks, outreach sequencing strategy, and performance accountability

• Implement and iterate on AI SDR tools (e.g., Unify, 11x, Clay) to expand outbound reach with high-quality, personalized messaging at scale

• Define territory and account coverage strategy in coordination with Sales leadership and RevOps

Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

• Genuinely energized by not knowing. The demand generation playbook is being rewritten right now, and you treat that as the most interesting part of the job rather than the unstable part. You ask the questions others skip past, even when it slows a decision down.

• Energized by finding new ways to apply AI to your own work and your team’s, with the judgment to tell a real efficiency gain from a good demo.

• Comfortable shipping a thoughtful first version and improving it on real feedback. You do not let a perfect program block pipeline this quarter, and when a bet does not land you recover fast, without drama.

• Connect program decisions to the revenue outcome, and think a step ahead about second-order effects: what a routing change does to SDR capacity, what a budget shift does to next quarter’s coverage.

• Treat a pipeline gap as your problem to solve regardless of which team owns the step that broke. You find the faster path and take it.

• Build all of the above into the team. You grow SDRs and marketers who take ownership, stay curious through change, and move without waiting for direction.

• Credible and data-driven in front of Sales, RevOps, and Marketing leadership, and equally comfortable in the campaign details.

Education & Experience

• 10+ years of B2B SaaS demand generation, growth marketing, or revenue marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

• Proven track record of building and scaling integrated demand programs that deliver measurable pipeline growth in mid-market and enterprise sales motions

• Experience managing or closely partnering with SDR or BDR teams, with a working understanding of the inbound and outbound pipeline model

• Background in content-led and thought leadership demand programs, not just paid media

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce, including attribution, lead routing, and funnel reporting

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $XYZ and $XYZ per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

• Celigo is a Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS for the second year in a row.

• Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year

• Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.

• Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you’ll experience

• Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency

• A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented

• Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field

• Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily

• Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

• Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)

• Wellness days and holidays to recharge

• Parental leave and a generous benefits package

• Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

jobs.description:
Join the ACI Learning Adventure!

Our Mission

Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.

We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.

The ACI Team

Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.

Purpose-Driven Culture

At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.

Your Opportunity

Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!

Who We Are

ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.

We are seeking a high-performing Academic Account Executive to accelerate adoption of our solutions within higher education institutions, including universities and colleges. In this role, you will work with cybersecurity and IT instructors and department leaders to demonstrate how ACI Learning’s Training and Skill Labs help them deliver the student outcomes they need. You will combine strategic selling with strong education market awareness to navigate complex buying processes and close new business in your territory.

What You’ll Do

• Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas.

• Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline

• Become deeply knowledgeable in our products and technologies so you can explain them clearly and simply to target buyers.

• Quickly research prospect accounts, identify target buyers and opportunities, and close them.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clean data and timely, reliable sales forecasts.

What We’re Looking For (Requirements)

• 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience selling SaaS or software solutions to senior technical buyers.

• Proven success achieving sales quota multiple years in a row at the same company.

• Experience closing new customers with an average order value of at least $5K to $20K.

• Experience with Salesforce, Outreach or SalesLoft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Smart, curious salespeople who ask strong questions, use data to make decisions, and are self-motivated.

We Prefer

• Understanding of cybersecurity and IT technologies and trends, or a demonstrated ability to sell complex software or SaaS technologies.

• Background in higher education sales, particularly selling to department heads and faculty. Knowledge of academic buying seasonality and processes is especially helpful.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.

Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.

Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.

401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.

Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Billing & Collections
jobs.description:
Pie's mission is to empower small businesses to thrive by making commercial insurance affordable and as easy as pie. We leverage technology to transform how small businesses buy and experience commercial insurance.

Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by core values and operating principles that guide every decision we make.

As the Team Lead, Billing & Collections, you own the end-to-end process for past-due receivable collections — installment payments, short-rated policies, claim deductibles, audit surcharge fees, and additional premium from mid-term endorsements or end-of-policy audits. You are accountable for Pie's overall bad debt recovery rate and for driving collection, litigation, and settlement outcomes against internal targets. You lead a team of individual contributors alongside BPO and offshore partners, set the strategy for how every dollar of exposure gets pursued, and continuously find upstream improvements that reduce Pie's exposure before receivables ever reach collections.

You set and enforce service-level agreements across the collection lifecycle and are accountable for the performance of your team, your vendors, and your BPO and offshore partners against defined KPIs. You partner with Accounting to establish and maintain allowance processes and month-end financial close recommendations and documentation. You are the decision-maker for collection referrals and vendor preference, and you make sure collection progress is visible and tracked across Pie's systems and vendor systems. This is a role for someone who wants to own a function, build it, and be measured on results.

How You’ll Do It

Own recovery outcomes across every policy in collections

• Own Pie's bad debt recovery rate. You're accountable for driving collection success against internal collection-rate and recovery targets, and for the outcomes of litigation and settlement.

• Set and enforce service-level agreements across the full collection lifecycle — from receivable handoff and outreach cadence through referral timing and final closeout — and hold your team, vendors, and BPO and offshore partners accountable to those SLAs and KPIs.

• Own and continuously improve the collection assignment process and vendor preference lists, including placement for unpaid installment invoices, surcharge fees, and final invoices following audit close.

• Prioritize collection effort on a risk basis, focusing attention on the large and jumbo balances that drive the majority of exposure.

• Make sure every call, letter, and text complies with the FDCPA, Regulation F, the TCPA, and applicable state debt-collection laws. Partner with Compliance and Legal on consent, opt-out, and disclosure requirements.

• Serve as the top-level point of contact for collection issues, complaints, and escalations, acting as subject matter expert and business stakeholder advocate within Pie.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to build the systems and automations that streamline collections — automated ordering, tracking data, KPI reporting, and automated action triggers and process steps.

• Track and drive continuous improvement for bad debt allowance processes, in partnership with Accounting.

• Coordinate dispute resolution cross-functionally and identify upstream process improvements that reduce bad debt exposure.

• Ensure timely closeout for all receivables at the end of collections or litigation.

• Partner cross-functionally to ensure trackability, visibility, and assignment inclusion for policy and collection-handling data — the source that powers Collections KPI tracking and management.

• Monitor collection progress and make or propose escalation approvals based on defined debt-amount thresholds.

Manage collection vendors and litigation

• Partner with Legal to drive litigation and settlement strategy and outcomes, and establish fast-track referral criteria for high-risk accounts — explicit refusal to pay, payment-plan default, or flight risk — so accounts are pursued before they age out of viability.

• Manage litigation decisions, billing, documentation, and judgment readiness.

• Create and maintain vendor scorecards covering recovery rates, timeliness, and other key data points.

• Partner with vendors to design and implement quality improvements based on scorecard findings.

• Review and update vendor guidelines regularly, and communicate any changes, additions, or deletions to vendor partners in a timely manner.

• Manage vendor billing.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for vendors on escalations and approval requests.

• Research, propose, and vet potential new vendor partners.

Lead and grow the collections team

• Lead, develop, and manage the performance of the collections team, including BPO and offshore resources — setting clear benchmarks, coaching to them, and actively managing underperformance through improvement plans up to and including off-boarding.

• Develop and maintain SOPs for collections processes to ensure timely handling, dispute management, and proper receivable closeouts.

• Establish benchmarks and KPIs for the team and individual contributors, and manage business performance and productivity.

• Drive process improvement and optimization of existing processes through Agile methodology.

• Manage onboarding, ongoing training and development, and offboarding for team members. Coordinate training strategy and identify growth areas in partnership with Enablement and Learning and Organizational Development.

• Serve as an escalation point for complex customer inquiries, questions, and disputes, and skillfully handle follow-up.

The Right Stuff

• A high school diploma or GED is required. An Associate's or Bachelor's degree is preferred.

• 3+ years of team leadership or people management experience, including managing performance, required.

• 1+ year of Premium Audit experience preferred.

• Experience in commercial insurance preferred.

• 2+ years of vendor management experience required.

• 1+ year of experience managing BPO or offshore teams preferred.

• 1+ year of experience with data analysis and an understanding of workers' comp operational practices required. A strong understanding of Pie's products and systems is required.

• LEAN Certification preferred.

• Working knowledge of debt-collection regulations — the FDCPA, Regulation F, and the TCPA — and applicable state laws required.

• Communicate clearly and convincingly in writing and out loud, present your own views, and make requests directly and openly. You close the loop, and you give and receive feedback with empathy. You bring professional maturity, customer empathy, and an owner's attitude. You can build bad debt allowance formulations complete with financial close documentation and back-testable, documented assumptions.

• Analyze and solve simple to complex problems independently and use data to make informed decisions. You design win-win solutions with creativity and good judgment, challenge the status quo, and apply agile thinking — testing ideas, iterating on findings, and refining before you launch the full solution.

• Learn from mistakes, aim to be better tomorrow than today, and raise the performance bar. You seek to understand, stay open to new information and change, and question assumptions while applying new context.

• Demonstrate interpersonal awareness — considering the needs of others, building collaborative relationships, and respecting individual and cultural differences. You gain cooperation by delivering results and building buy-in.

jobs.title: Local Justice Account Executive - West US
jobs.description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

The role

The Local Justice Account Executive - West US at Peregrine is responsible for expanding our footprint across the local justice ecosystem including Prosecution and Probation. We’re looking for a top-tier hunter who thrives in complex, relationship-driven environments and understands the unique needs, pressures, and political structures of the criminal justice system.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of breaking into new public sector markets and turning small footholds into durable, scalable deployments. You will navigate multi-stakeholder scenarios across the local criminal justice community, including county leadership—using empathetic curiosity to identify opportunities, build trust, negotiate, close, and support mission-critical customers.

You’ll become a trusted advisor to your justice partners by deeply understanding their operational workflows, common pain points, case management challenges, discovery obligations, and technology roadmaps. You will help translate Peregrine’s capabilities into tailored, defensible solutions that strengthen their ability to deliver fair, efficient, and transparent justice for their communities. This is a rare opportunity to fundamentally shape how the local criminal justice system operates through the application of modern technology solutions during a period of tremendous growth at Peregrine.

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Territory Development: Own the Local Justice sector in your region, with a strong emphasis on capitalizing on opportunities across District Attorneys’ Offices, Prosecutors, and City/State Attorneys. Identify, cultivate, and advance opportunities that exceed individual revenue targets and drive meaningful growth for Peregrine.

• Product Expertise: Develop deep fluency in Peregrine’s solutions and how they support prosecutorial workflows, case management, evidence handling, and community safety outcomes. Deliver compelling presentations and demos that clearly articulate product features, differentiators, and real-world impact to legal and operational stakeholders

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build trust-based relationships across Local Justice offices by immersing yourself in their day-to-day challenges, technology gaps, and long-term strategic needs. Communicate Peregrine’s value proposition effectively to diverse audiences.

• Pipeline Cultivation: Proactively generate, qualify, and advance a healthy pipeline aligned to the unique rhythms of justice system procurement cycles. Stay attuned to policy changes, funding opportunities, and evolving market dynamics to identify short- and long-term opportunities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with deployment, marketing, product, legal, and operations teams to ensure a seamless customer experience from discovery through close. Orchestrate multifaceted initiatives that support customer success and long-term adoption.

• Innovative Problem-Solving: Leverage insights from internal experts and external advisors to develop creative, tailored solutions that redefine what’s possible in technology.

About You

• You are outcome-focused and can expertly navigate complex, politically nuanced environments.

• You understand the organizational variances of the local justice community from state to state and jurisdiction to jurisdiction.

• You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo, refusing to believe that the current state is simply “good enough”.

• You excel at problem-solving and bring curiosity and respect for the missions, constraints, and pressures justice leaders face.

• You guide customers across the finish line with resilience, professionalism, and a service-oriented mindset.

• You see opportunities where others see bureaucratic obstacles.

• You’re an empathetic listener who invests deeply in understanding a customer’s operational and legal challenges, crafting tailored solutions that meet their needs.

• You’re confident in ambiguity and creative in your approach when navigating multi-agency stakeholders and public procurement processes.

• You make advanced technology feel accessible and human—acting as the bridge between justice practitioners and innovative tools.

• You’re a lifelong learner willing to dive into the details, and understanding the nuances, of the local criminal justice workflows.

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Ping Identity is seeking a high-performing, strategically minded Enterprise Account Executive, Greenfield to accelerate net-new logo growth across a focused set of enterprise accounts in the $1B-$2B revenue segment. This role is responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new platform opportunities in greenfield accounts, expanding Ping Identity’s presence with organizations that are modernizing workforce, customer, and agent identity.

This is a true new-logo role for a proven enterprise seller who knows how to build a territory, create executive access, run disciplined account plans, and close complex multi-stakeholder transactions. The successful candidate brings the credibility to engage CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, product and security architects, infrastructure leaders, and line-of-business stakeholders, while orchestrating internal and partner resources to win strategic identity platform decisions. What you will accomplish

• Partner closely with global systems integrators, regional partners, resellers, and technology alliances to create pipeline, strengthen account access, and improve win rates.

Drive platform expansion from the initial land

• Identify and develop expansion opportunities following the initial win, including additional products, broader workforce adoption, customer identity use cases, new regions, and adjacent security initiatives.

Qualifications

Preferred qualifications

About the Role

Sales Strategy & Operations at Motive drives the strategy, execution, and scale of Motive's revenue growth. Our work is cross-functional and touches nearly every part of the business.

We are looking for a Sales Strategy & Operations Manager to support our Strategic segment — the largest and most complex fleets in our market, where a single account can represent millions in ARR and a multi-year, multi-product relationship. This is our highest-stakes book of business, and the operating rigor behind it has to match the size of the prize.

We are looking for someone who will bring innovation, experience, and a fresh perspective to our team. Your ability to think strategically, adapt quickly, and get things done will earn credibility with all levels of the organization. Our mandate is to make the sales motion run more effectively, efficiently, and ultimately drive higher productivity. This role will bring a data driven perspective to forecasting, pipeline generation and management, territory design, and other sales metrics. You will collaborate closely with Strategic Sales Leadership, the Enterprise Sales Operations team, and the broader Go-to-Market organization, and will direct analytical support from our Strategy & Operations team in Pakistan.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the primary sales operations business partner to Strategic Sales Leadership and their Directors of Strategic Accounts

• Pinpoint the drivers of performance in a low-volume, high-value motion and lead initiatives to increase win rates, deal velocity, and multi-product attach

• Own territory design and book-of-business optimization, moving from one-size-fits-all account counts to a variable model that reflects account potential, incumbent providers, and industry focus

• Own key reporting and analytics for the Strategic team (Salesforce, Google Sheets, Hex on Snowflake) and build the analytical tools leaders need to understand their business

• Build your own leverage — use AI and automation tooling (Glean agents, Google Apps Script, n8n) to eliminate manual reporting and workflow steps rather than absorbing them

• Partner with cross-functional teams to scope and execute strategic projects that reduce workflow friction and inefficiencies for the sales organization

What We Hope You Bring

• 6+ years of Field Sales/Revenue Operations experience at a high-growth SaaS company, including direct support of an Enterprise or Strategic segment

• Comfort operating in a low-volume, high-ACV motion where deal-level judgment matters as much as aggregate trend analysis

• Exceptional spreadsheet and data management skills to quickly structure analyses, answer key business questions, and drive decision making

• Experience in building Salesforce reports and dashboards, knowledge in how SFDC applications integrate with each other, and ability to enable sales on SFDC best practices and related tools

• Experience partnering with Sales Leadership on initiatives such as weekly forecasting, territory alignment, ROE, QBRs and other related projects

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

Alo is looking for a Lead Martech Engineer to design, build, and scale the technology that powers retention, personalization, and cross-channel customer journeys. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, data, and engineering, owning the technical foundation behind Customer 360, lifecycle orchestration, experimentation, and measurement.

You’ll play a key role in operationalizing customer data through a CDP and reverse ETL tooling into activation platforms such as Braze, enabling scalable, measurable lifecycle and retention programs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Martech Platform & Journey Orchestration

• Own the technical integration and data ingestion for retention, lifecycle, and loyalty programs (partnering with Engineering on core loyalty logic).

• Design and implement cross-channel journeys using Braze and related orchestration tools

• Build reusable triggers, templates, and journey patterns that scale across teams and use cases

Customer 360 & Data Enablement

• Partner with Data Engineering to design and operationalize Customer 360

• Use reverse ETL tools to sync customer profiles, traits, and audiences from data platforms into the CDP and Braze

• Ensure consistency of identity resolution, consent flags, and audience logic across systems

• Maintain clear ownership of marketing data definitions and source-of-truth alignment

Eventing, Triggers & Real-Time Activation

• Support event-driven activation and near real-time personalization

• Define lifecycle signals and behavioral triggers that power journeys and messaging

• Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability across event pipelines

Experimentation & Measurement

• Enable A/B testing, holdouts, and incrementality measurement for lifecycle and retention programs
