jobs.title: Global Content Communications Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Global Content Communications Senior Specialist

San Mateo, CA (Collab)

Role Overview

Within Global Content Communications, this role will help shape how PlayStation collaborates with game publishers and developers, and will take a prominent role in planning, creating, and managing content focused on third-party titles published on PlayStation. Our goal is to elevate our third-party partners and create the most engaging content for gamers around the world.

This role will identify and develop content opportunities around exciting upcoming games of all shapes and sizes working with Sony Interactive Entertainment's Global Developer and Publisher Relations team as well as external studios and publishers. Content types will include news articles on PlayStation.Blog, as well as gameplay videos and other socially optimized content for PlayStation social channels including Instagram, TikTok, and more. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of the games industry with strong content-creation instincts, social media expertise, and an ability to build trusted relationships with internal teams and external partners.

The role will sit within Global Content Communications and partner closely with teams across Sony Interactive, including Global Communications, Global Third-Party Marketing, Third-Party Portfolio, and Games Account Management, as well as external game publishers and developers.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintain deep knowledge of upcoming games, publisher plans, industry trends, and player interests to proactively identify promising content opportunities.

• Proactively develop and pitch creative ideas for PlayStation Blog, social media, video, and other Sony Interactive-owned channels that give players new reasons to engage with upcoming games.

• Shape content plans around major third-party game campaigns, identifying the moments, stories, and content most likely to resonate with PlayStation audiences globally.

• Pitch and develop content opportunities including game reveals, new gameplay, developer interviews, hands-on coverage, original social content, and other creative storytelling.

• Develop simple, scalable processes that help the team organize upcoming third-party campaigns and content opportunities.

• Partner closely with Sony Interactive Third-Party Marketing, Games Account Management, and other internal teams to develop content opportunities for third-party games.

• Work across Sony Interactive teams to connect third-party content opportunities with broader PlayStation priorities, including PlayStation Plus and PlayStation Store.

• Develop content plans with Sony Interactive’s international social media teams in mind, identifying opportunities that can extend across markets and collaborating with regional teammates to support global campaigns.

• Help publishers understand the value of partnering with PlayStation by sharing content performance, audience insights, and learnings from previous campaigns.

What We're Looking For

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in social media management and content creation, editorial content creation, corporate communications, content strategy, games marketing, or a related field.

• Experience working in the video game industry is strongly preferred, given the need for this role to have deep and broad knowledge of the landscape. Candidates with a background in social media, editorial and content creation, communications, publisher relations, marketing, or third-party games will have the most relevant experience for this role. Candidates with relevant experience in entertainment, media, or other consumer-facing industries -- and a deep knowledge of games -- will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of major social platforms and the types of content, formats, and storytelling approaches that resonate with their audiences.

• Deep knowledge of the video game industry, including major publishers, developers, independent games, franchises, industry trends, and how games are communicated and marketed to players.

• Strong editorial and creative instincts, with the ability to quickly identify what makes a game, announcement, asset, or developer story interesting to an audience.

• Highly proactive and comfortable identifying and pursuing opportunities rather than waiting for assignments or incoming requests.

• Experience working directly with external partners, with the confidence to pitch ideas, respond to opportunities, provide constructive feedback, and build trusted working relationships.

• Experience developing content for global audiences and an understanding of how campaigns and creative ideas can be adapted or extended across international markets.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple games, campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

• Comfortable working creatively within constraints, including developing compelling content opportunities when assets, timing, or resources may be limited.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and build alignment across internal and external stakeholders.

• Collaborative, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and opportunities can change quickly.

• Ability to use content performance and audience insights to inform future recommendations and demonstrate the value of content partnerships.

• Requires familiarity with collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace), while working knowledge of common content creation tools is a major plus (Adobe Creative Suite such as Premiere Pro and Photoshop).

• Education: BS preferred -- ideally in related fields such as PR/Communication, Marketing, or Film -- but not necessarily required with a strong portfolio or relevant job experience.

The ideal candidate will possess one or more of the following additional specialized skills

• Proficiency using Adobe Premiere Pro to edit video, including vertical video formats like TikTok and Instagram Reels.

• Expertise with creating native TikTok content, including deep knowledge of trends, content creation, and related production experience.

• Professional-grade photography skills, including product, event, and creative photography.

• Experience using AI to automate and improve content-gathering processes.

• Experience with community management strategy and community relations programs.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Compeer Financial is a member-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

• Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months

The contributions you will make:

The Infrastructure Engineering Intern is a temporary developmental role designed to provide practical experience supporting the technology platforms that enable Compeer’s business operations. Working with guidance from experienced infrastructure engineers, this role contributes to well-defined activities that improve the reliability, availability, security, documentation, and lifecycle management of infrastructure services.

The intern will gain exposure to enterprise infrastructure, including cloud and on-premises platforms, storage, compute, networking, monitoring, automation, disaster recovery, and technical service management. The role develops technical, professional, and business capabilities while helping the team advance meaningful reliability, resiliency, and modernization work.

• Assist with maintaining infrastructure documentation, runbooks, inventories, dependency information, lifecycle records, and operational reports.

• Help gather, validate, and organize data to support infrastructure lifecycle planning, technical debt identification, platform health assessments, and audit or remediation activities.

• Participate in monitoring and observability activities by reviewing alerts, trends, dashboards, and capacity or performance information with team guidance.

• Assist with the creation and maintenance of automation scripts, repeatable procedures, and operational documentation.

• Support disaster recovery, resiliency, and business-continuity readiness activities through documentation, evidence collection, exercise preparation, and follow-up tracking.

• Participate in incident, problem, and change-management activities as appropriate; contribute to root-cause learning and continuous-improvement efforts.

• Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate research, documentation, analysis, and routine work while validating results, protecting sensitive information, and maintaining human accountability.

• Collaborate with infrastructure engineers, security, architecture, application teams, service management, vendors, and business partners.

• Seek coaching, apply feedback, build technical knowledge, and demonstrate accountability for personal growth and assigned deliverables.

The skills and experience we prefer you have:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Management Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• Coursework, projects, or experience related to systems administration, networking, cloud computing, cybersecurity, automation, databases, or enterprise technology.

• Foundational understanding of operating systems, networking concepts, servers, cloud platforms, or infrastructure services.

• Familiarity with one or more scripting or automation languages, such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or a comparable language.

• Exposure to monitoring, logging, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, or IT service-management concepts is preferred.

• Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to gather data, identify trends, document findings, and follow established processes.

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and ask thoughtful questions when clarification is needed.

• Ability to manage assigned work, adapt to changing priorities, and follow through on commitments.

• Demonstrated curiosity, learning agility, attention to detail, and interest in building a career in infrastructure engineering or technology operations.

• Commitment to protecting confidential information and following security, change-management, and technology standards.

How we will take care of you:

Actual hourly rate offered is dependent upon year in school, work experience, transferable skills, business needs and market demands. The hourly rate range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Base Pay

$20—$21 USD

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Fortune Brands is hiring a Product Manager to support a product line within our Moen water brand.

As a Product Manager, you will play an important role in supporting the growth and success of assigned product lines within the Moen B2C business, with a focus on faucet valves.

You will help shape product strategies by aligning product offerings, channels, and pricing in ways that meet both customer and business needs.

This role calls for curiosity, empathy, and thoughtful analysis to understand market trends and customer experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to develop meaningful strategies, communicate shared goals, and contribute to outcomes that strengthen market presence over time. This entails a strong business acumen with a technical aptitude to become a SME of the inner workings of the associated products you support.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of fluid-control technologies and consumer-facing products. They can translate customer insights, competitive analysis, and technical requirements into a compelling product strategy, while partnering with engineering teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and market-leading plumbing or fluid-control solutions.

POSITION LOCATION: This is a hybrid position based in our world-class Deerfield, IL campus, with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.

What you will be doing:

• Support the development of strategic product plans by aligning pricing, distribution, and promotional approaches with long-term business goals to support sustainable revenue and market growth.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to guide new product development and innovation initiatives through the full stage-gate process.
• Build collaborative relationships with external customers by sharing insights and helping identify opportunities for category growth.
• Work closely with Revenue Growth Management, Sales, Analytics, and Finance teams to better understand channel dynamics and evaluate pricing strategies.
• Contribute to go-to-market approaches by sharing perspectives and helping guide product and business decisions.
• Collaborate with Operations, including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality, to support product launches and monitor ongoing product performance.
• Advocate for the voice of the customer by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, preferences, and market trends.
• Communicate product strategies and priorities clearly and thoughtfully to a variety of stakeholders.
• Support sales teams through training, participation in industry events, and ongoing engagement with partners and associations.
• Partner with Brand, Channel Marketing, Digital, and Commercialization teams to co-create marketing materials and promotional strategies.
• Review product-related communications to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams and external partners on product offerings and updates.
• Maintain regular, supportive communication with field sales teams, including occasional travel (approximately 15%).
• Contribute to additional projects and responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or related field.
• 3+ years of proven product management experience
• Experience managing products within the fashion plumbing, kitchen and bath, or water delivery product categories OR other valve, cartridge, and fluid control technologies, including thermostatic and pressure-balancing mechanisms.
• Understanding of sealing technologies, including elastomeric and ceramic components, as well as flow performance, cavitation, acoustic/noise reduction, and durability requirements.
• Experience with high-volume manufactured products in industries such as plumbing, appliance, HVAC/R, water heating, beverage dispensing, or automotive fluid control systems.
• Ability to translate customer needs, competitive analysis, and engineering requirements into product strategy, roadmap priorities, and successful product launches.
• Experience partnering closely with market-facing roles (such as Sales) and partnering with technical roles (engineering) to bring a quality product portfolio to market
• Strong analytical and communication skills to support collaborative decision-making.
• Technical aptitude and the ability to understand the engineering, functionality, and internal mechanics imperative to the product while having the business acumen (financials) to build strong business cases, derive market insights and product trends to ensure portfolio success.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 15%.

Preferred Qualifications:

• MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
• Ideal candidates will have experience in fashion plumbing developing high-volume consumer, commercial, or automotive products that incorporate fluid control systems, including thermostatic and pressure-compensating valves, cartridges, elastomeric and ceramic sealing technologies, flow regulation, noise and cavitation management, and durability/lifecycle performance.
• Experience with both B2C and B2B product environments.
• Familiarity with connected product technologies or smart home categories.

jobs.title: Partner Activation Manager
jobs.description:
AvePoint is seeking a Partner Activation Manager to join our Global Channel Marketing team. In this role, you will design and scale the programs, campaigns, and digital experiences that help new partners successfully onboard, engage with AvePoint, and become productive members of our partner ecosystem.

Working across regional channel teams, partner operations, enablement, and marketing, you will create scalable activation programs that accelerate partner readiness, drive engagement with enablement resources, and improve partner time-to-value.

This role offers the opportunity to shape how partners engage, learn, and become productive across a global ecosystem. You will have meaningful ownership of the partner activation experience and work with teams across the business to build programs that scale. With a focus on but not limited to:

Partner Activation & Onboarding

• Own partner activation campaigns across the recruit-to-activate journey.

• Design and manage onboarding journeys that help new partners become productive more quickly.

• Coordinate global activation campaigns and onboarding programs from planning through execution.

• Partner with regional teams to adapt and deliver activation programs for local needs.

• Build scalable onboarding frameworks, playbooks, and campaign journeys that support partner activation across multiple partner types and regions.

• Partner with operations teams to optimize activation workflows, automate engagement programs, and improve the overall partner onboarding experience.

Online Partner Enablement

• Own the digital partner enablement experience, ensuring partners can easily access the training, resources, programs, and tools needed to become successful.

• Build and maintain scalable, self-service enablement resources.

• Drive partner engagement with enablement content, learning pathways, and certifications.

• Collaborate with Product Marketing and Content teams to keep partner-facing assets current and relevant.

Measurement & Optimization

• Define and track activation metrics including onboarding engagement, enablement adoption, partner activation rates and time-to-productivity metrics.

• Test and refine activation campaigns, onboarding journeys, and digital experiences based on performance insights.

• Share clear performance reporting, recommendations, and areas of opportunity with leadership.

• Use data and partner feedback to identify friction points and continuously improve activation experiences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Align with Partner Program Operations on the workflows that support partner activation.

• Work across Channel, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, and regional teams to deliver a consistent partner experience.

• Serve as the central coordinator for global partner activation initiatives, aligning stakeholders across channel marketing, partner operations, enablement, product marketing, and regional teams.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured through improvements in partner activation, faster time-to-productivity, increased onboarding completion, greater adoption of enablement resources and certifications, and consistent delivery of high-quality activation campaigns. The ideal candidate will help build scalable programs that enable partners to engage more quickly, access the right resources, and achieve value faster.

Qualifications:

• Experience in channel marketing, partner programs, partner enablement, lifecycle marketing, customer onboarding, or a related field.

• Demonstrated success owning campaigns, onboarding programs, or enablement initiatives from concept through execution.

• Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders.

• Experience developing digital or self-service content that drives adoption and engagement.

• A data-driven approach to measuring program performance and identifying opportunities to improve.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams.

• Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly execution-oriented in a fast-paced, global environment.

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting partner, alliance, or channel ecosystems within a B2B technology or SaaS organization.

• Familiarity with partner enablement platforms, learning management systems, partner relationship management platforms, or marketing automation tools.

• Experience building global programs that can be adapted for regional execution.

• Understanding of partner engagement, activation, adoption, and lifecycle marketing principles.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role:

Halcyon is seeking a seasoned and collaborative Senior Information Security Specialist to support the advancement of our cybersecurity and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) programs. In this role, you will play a critical part in strengthening our enterprise-wide security posture by coordinating across teams, managing third-party risk, supporting compliance initiatives, and maturing internal security processes and documentation. Your responsibilities will span operational security, risk assessment, policy development, and incident response preparedness.

Responsibilities:

• Perform and maintain third-party risk assessments and track vendor remediation activities.

• Support coordination and analysis of internal and external security testing, including vulnerability scans and penetration tests.

• Develop, track, and follow up on corrective action plans for identified security gaps or audit findings.

• Collaborate with managed security service providers and internal stakeholders to monitor and manage security events and escalations.

• Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure implementation of security and compliance requirements across the organization.

• Assist in developing, maintaining, and communicating information security policies, standards, and procedures.

• Coordinate security incident response planning, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity exercises.

• Monitor and support enforcement of technical and administrative security controls across the enterprise.

• Stay current with evolving security and privacy regulations and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, TX-RAMP, FedRAMP).

Skills and Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or IT risk management.

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, controls, and risk frameworks.

• Demonstrated experience with third-party risk management processes and tooling.

• Proven ability to coordinate security testing and vulnerability management efforts.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to assess and implement technical and administrative controls across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Experience with regulatory compliance and audit support in fast-paced environments.

• Hands-on participation in incident response or disaster recovery exercises is a plus.

Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

• Experience with compliance platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta).

• Knowledge of security frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO 27001, such as NIST 800-53 or CIS Controls.

• Familiarity with secure software development practices or DevSecOps principles.

• Background in auditing or supporting third-party security assessments.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace security configuration.

• Exposure to regulatory environments such as HIPAA, GDPR, or CCPA.

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+, or similar are a plus.

• Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

• Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

• Medical and dependent care FSA options.

• 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

• Parental leave.

• Generous equity offerings.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Data Center Infrastructure/Cabling
jobs.description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview:

As a Technical Project Manager, you will manage large scale cabling infrastructure deployments for major AI and hyperscale data centers across the U.S. This position will focus on planning, coordination, documentation, reporting, and overall project delivery.

You will work closely with clients, project teams, leadership, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure infrastructure deployments are completed safely, accurately, on schedule, and within budget. The ideal candidate has experience managing AI infrastructure, data center cabling, low-voltage, network infrastructure, or other IT infrastructure for large-scale deployments.

• This is a full-time, salaried position, full benefits, paid time off, paid training, and performance-based bonuses.

• Candidates may be based in another approved location if they are comfortable with approximately 50% travel. Relocation assistance may also be available for candidates interested in living near the project site.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage data center cabling and infrastructure projects from planning through closeout

• Create and maintain project schedules, budgets, milestones, risk logs, and resource plans

• Coordinate with clients, field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders

• Track project progress, identify risks, and resolve schedule or deployment issues

• Manage RFIs, change orders, submittals, status reports, and closeout documentation

• Track materials, equipment readiness, labor, project costs, and change orders

• Lead client and internal project meetings and provide clear status updates

• Partner with Superintendents and Foremen to ensure field work meets project requirements

• Support QA/QC, testing, commissioning, turnover, and project closeout

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of project management experience supporting data centers, structured cabling, low-voltage, network infrastructure, server or compute deployments, or similar technology infrastructure projects

• Experience managing multiple teams, vendors, locations, or concurrent projects

• Experience managing schedules, budgets, risks, documentation, and client expectations

• Strong organizational, communication, and customer-facing skills

• Proficiency with Excel and project management, scheduling, or reporting platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with AI or hyperscale data center infrastructure deployments

• Knowledge of structured cabling, fiber, copper, racks, cabinets, containment, and cable pathways

• Experience working within a PMO or structured project delivery team

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Tier 2

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

jobs.title: Principal Manager, People Operations Business Partner
jobs.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position summary

The Principal Manager, HR Business Partner is a strategic people leader responsible for the direction, effectiveness, and growth of Nava's HR Business Partner function, including the direct management and development of the People Operations Business Partner (POBP). This role sets the strategy for how Nava's people practices support the business, translating enterprise priorities into workforce frameworks, organizational design principles, and talent strategies that HR Business Partners apply across their assigned business areas.

The Principal Manager builds a high-performing People Operations Business Partner team, coaching and developing POBP talent while serving as a trusted strategic advisor to senior executives on organizational structure, workforce planning, performance, and labor and employee relations. This role co-owns the enterprise frameworks: workforce planning, career pathing, and organizational design standards that POBP’s use to advise business leaders, and ensures those frameworks remain consistent, equitable, and aligned with Nava's mission.

As Nava evolves toward an AI-native operating model, the Principal Manager, People Operations Business Partners sets the strategic point of view on how artificial intelligence and automation will change roles, skills, team structures, and management practices, and equips the POBP team to guide leaders through that change responsibly, balancing efficiency gains with employee trust, equity, compliance, and sound human judgment. Working closely with People Operations leadership, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business operations leaders, the Manager ensures that people strategy and POBP practice are financially responsible, legally compliant, operationally practical, and aligned with Nava's values.

All responsibilities will be carried out in service of Nava’s values: Be Active Stewards, Delivery over Dogma, Build Together, Innovation Requires New Perspectives, and Progress Takes Work.

What you'll do

• Directly manage, coach, and develop the People Operations Business Partner, setting clear goals and providing regular feedback and career development support

• Build and scale the People Operations Business Partner function across the employee lifecycle managing the workload distribution as the organization scales

• Establish performance expectations, competencies, and quality standards for POBP work and regularly assess the team

• Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and continuous improvement within the POBP team

• Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior executives on organizational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employee relations

• Translate enterprise business priorities into people strategy, ensuring HRBP practice aligns with company goals

• Set the strategic point of view on how AI and automation will affect roles, skills, team structures, and management practices, and equip HRBPs to guide leaders through responsible adoption

• Partner with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and Learning & Organization Enablement leadership to deliver a cohesive, enterprise-wide employee experience

• Represent the People Operations Business Partner function in enterprise-level people strategy and planning discussions

• Develop and maintain Nava's enterprise workforce-planning frameworks, and career-pathing structures that POBPs apply across business areas

• Partner with Finance, Operations, and Delivery business leaders to align workforce plans with delivery commitments, organizational capacity, and financial plans

• Guide organizational design decisions, including team restructures, leadership transitions, position eliminations, and other significant workforce actions

• Evaluate spans of control, reporting structures, and organizational capability across the business to identify opportunities for greater effectiveness

• Set standards for evaluating technology-enabled efficiency proposals, ensuring they are supported by realistic change-management plans and workforce data

• Coach the POBP team on how to develop leaders and managers on organizational leadership, team effectiveness, accountability, and performance

• Identify recurring, cross-organizational manager challenges and direct the development of scalable tools, guidance, and learning interventions

• Champion the build of inclusive, accountable, and psychologically safe teams across the business

• Guide the POBP team through complex or sensitive leadership situations, promoting sound judgment, consistency, and fairness

• Own the people and organizational strategy for significant business changes, setting direction for the HRBP team's execution

• Direct assessments of stakeholder impact, organizational readiness, and employee-relations risk for major change initiatives

• Set change-management standards and ensure the HRBP team delivers clear implementation plans, communications, and manager resources

• Monitor the impact of organizational changes at the enterprise level and adjust strategy based on workforce data and outcomes

• Serve as an escalation point for complex, high-risk, or sensitive labor and employee relations matters

• Partner with Legal and People Operations leadership on high-impact investigations and risk assessments

• Maintain enterprise-level knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements and ensure HRBP practice reflects current law

• Set the strategy for employee- and labor-relations practices related to AI-enabled workplace changes, including monitoring, workload, and role requirements

• Support employee-relations practices within Nava's unionized environment and ensure compliance with collective bargaining obligations

• Identify systemic patterns in employee concerns and direct the development of organization-wide solutions

• Escalate significant organizational, legal, cultural, or employee-experience risks appropriately

• Sponsor and oversee complex, cross-functional people initiatives from problem definition through implementation and evaluation

• Coordinate with leaders across People Operations, Finance, Legal, IT, Talent Acquisition, and delivery teams

• Provide clear, executive-level updates on initiative progress, risk, and outcomes

• Ensure initiatives are meaningfully adopted and sustained across the organization

• Set the strategy for using workforce data to identify trends, organizational health indicators, and emerging risks

• Partner with People Workforce Insights, Staffing, and Finance to improve enterprise workforce reporting and decision-making

• Translate data into clear insights and recommendations for executive leadership

• Ensure appropriate data integrity, confidentiality, and documentation standards across the POBP function

• Drive cross-functional initiatives that improve the employee and manager experience

• Identify and resolve policies, processes, systems, or operating practices that create unnecessary complexity, inconsistency, risk, or administrative burden

• Direct improvements that increase clarity, scalability, compliance, and organizational effectiveness

• Ensure People Operations programs and processes are practical for managers and aligned with Nava’s broader people strategy

• Champion the adoption of self-service tools and standardized practices while preserving appropriate judgment for complex situations

Required skills

• 10+ years of People Operations and/or Human Resources experience

• Demonstrated experience translating business strategy into organizational design, workforce planning, and talent strategy at the enterprise level

• Thorough knowledge of People Operations and Human Resources principles and applicable federal and state regulations (FMLA, ADA, FLSA, NLRA, etc.)

• Strong competency with HCM systems

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

• Experience coaching and developing talent

• Ability to develop and maintain collaborative working relationships with executives, managers, employees and union representatives

• Strong analytical skills and experience using workforce data to identify trends, evaluate risk, and support decisions

• Strong judgment and the ability to provide clear recommendations in complex, sensitive, or ambiguous situations

• Ability to develop and maintain collaborative working relationships with employees, managers, and union representatives

• Ability to work independently and with little supervision

• Extraordinary discretion, confidentiality, flexibility, and willingness to work closely with a cross-functional team

• Proficiency in GSuite, Slack, Zoom, Excel, Apple computers, and other tools used to support a remote-work environment

• Attention to detail and the ability to work independently and in a team environment

• Ability to work effectively in a distributed, remote-first environment

Desired skills

• Experience supporting a government contractor, professional-services organization, consulting organization, technology company, or project-based workforce

• Experience working in a unionized environment or supporting labor-relations matters

• Experience with Workday HCM

• Experience supporting organizational redesign, workforce restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, or other significant organizational changes

• Experience with job architecture, compensation administration, talent reviews, succession planning, or workforce analytics

• Experience supporting leaders in a rapidly evolving and scaling organization

Compensation

$132,000—$148,500 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States

Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs

Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost

Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge

Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO

Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus

Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home

Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools

Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)

Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest

401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan

Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities

Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs

Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses

Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills

Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs

Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team

Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable

Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:

Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin

*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.

Please contact the recruiting team at recruiting@navapbc.com if you would like to request reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.

We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Nava is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, gender and/or gender identity or expression, color, creed, religion, religious creed, age, national origin, ethnicity, disability, veteran or military status, sex, sexual orientation, reproductive health autonomy, pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth, genetic information, domestic violence victim status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Nava prohibits any such discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all employees, applicants, contractors, and temporary workers of Nava.

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top-tier trading experience.

About The Role & Team

We are looking for a Chief Marketing Officer to lead and scale the U.S. marketing function for our growing FINRA regulated financial services firm. This executive will be responsible for developing and executing a modern, data driven marketing strategy that strengthens brand presence, accelerates customer acquisition and retention, and supports sustainable business growth across the U.S. market. Reports to our Corporate SVP & Global CMO.

The ideal candidate brings a balance of strategic leadership and operational execution, with experience building scalable marketing programs within highly regulated industries. This leader will partner closely with executive leadership to elevate market positioning, drive measurable commercial impact, and ensure all marketing initiatives align with regulatory expectations and corporate objectives.

In This Role, You Will

• Lead U.S. Creative, Brand Marketing, and Product Marketing strategy, aligning priorities with the firm’s broader global marketing strategy and business objectives.
• Own customer acquisition strategy and performance, optimizing traffic, conversion, customer experience, acquisition costs, and channel investment to drive sustainable and profitable client growth.
• Own the development and execution of the U.S. brand strategy, positioning, messaging, and go to market approach across key products and customer segments.
• Drive integrated marketing strategies that strengthen brand awareness, support customer growth, and translate product capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.
• Lead and develop a high performing marketing organization of approximately 15 to 50 professionals across Creative, Brand Marketing, and Product Marketing.
• Partner closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership to align marketing priorities, customer experience, and business goals.
• Serve as a strategic marketing leader to the Global CMO and executive team, using market intelligence, customer insights, and performance data to shape growth strategy and investment priorities.

The Skills You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
• 10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, including significant experience leading and developing teams.
• Proven leadership experience across Creative, Brand Marketing, and Product Marketing, with a track record of building brands, launching products, and driving business growth.
• Experience in financial services, fintech, wealth management, brokerage, banking, or another highly regulated industry strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, customer engagement, acquisition, and retention.
• Strong strategic, analytical, and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence cross functional leaders, align priorities, and translate business objectives into compelling marketing strategies and execution.

What Makes You Stand Out

• Experience leading marketing for a high growth fintech, brokerage, financial services, or technology company, particularly in a consumer facing environment.
• Proven track record of transforming or scaling a brand, including repositioning a company, expanding market presence, or significantly increasing brand awareness and customer engagement.
• Experience marketing complex financial products and translating sophisticated products, technology, and capabilities into simple, compelling customer value propositions.
• Strong global perspective with experience partnering across international teams and markets, while effectively translating global strategy into a differentiated U.S. marketing approach.

Why Webull?

Webull is more than a fintech company—we’re a global community of innovators, collaborators, and trailblazers. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL, Webull operates in 16 regions worldwide, serving over 20 million users. At Webull, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work makes a real impact.

Investing in our people is a top priority for us, which is why we have a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: 100% paid medical and dental insurance for employees and dependents, vision insurance, and more!
• Financial Support: 401(k) match, commuter benefits for NY positions, and short-term disability coverage.
• Work-Life Balance: Generous time off that increases with tenure, paid parental leave, personal days, sick time, volunteer days and company holidays.
• Wellness & Pet Care: Fitness and wellness benefits, plus pet insurance for your furry friends.
• Investing in Your Future: We provide tuition reimbursement to help you pursue relevant degrees, certifications, and training that align with your career goals.
• Dynamic Office Perks: Catered breakfast (every Monday) & lunches (every Friday), fully stocked kitchens, and monthly happy hours to connect and collaborate.

This role is based in our 44 Wall Street office in New York City, NY, where in-person collaboration fuels growth, mentorship, and innovation. At Webull, we’re committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. The base salary range is $230,000-280,000.00 annually, plus a discretionary bonus and full benefits. Final offers consider experience, location, and relevant qualifications.

EEOC Statement

Webull is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where all backgrounds, perspectives, and talents are valued.

jobs.title: Pool Server - Full Time

jobs.title: Apartment Maintenance Technician - Citigate Apartment Homes

Whether you're preparing apartments for new move-ins or troubleshooting maintenance requests, you'll have the tools and support needed to perform at a high level every day.

• Budgeted hourly rate is between $19.00 and $22.00 per hour. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• Monthly Customer Service Satisfaction Bonuses. Technicians who excel at consistently providing positive resident experiences can earn up to $250 per month.

How We Support You

Who You Are

• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.

jobs.title: Payer Relations Clinician (LISW/LPCC)
jobs.description:
Lighthouse Behavioral Health Solutions (LBHS) offers a full continuum of care, including outpatient, intensive outpatient, partial hospitalization, residential treatment, psychiatric services, and medication‑assisted treatment. We take pride in creating a welcoming, compassionate environment where individuals feel supported. Our team believes in every client’s ability to achieve recovery and rebuild meaningful, engaged lives in their communities.

Payer Relations Clinician (LISW/LPCC)

Location: Columbus, OH (in person)
Department: Clinical Services
Reports To: Vice President of Clinical Services
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Lighthouse Behavioral Health Solutions

Lighthouse Behavioral Health Solutions (LBHS) is committed to improving access to high-quality behavioral health care through clinical excellence, evidence-based treatment, and continuous performance improvement. We are seeking an experienced clinician to serve as our Payer Relations Clinician, a key role responsible for representing the organization in payer clinical reviews, supporting medical necessity determinations, and identifying opportunities to improve authorization outcomes across our continuum of care.

Position Summary

The Payer Relations Clinician serves as the organization's primary clinical representative for peer-to-peer reviews with Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), commercial payers, Medicare Advantage plans, and other insurance representatives.

This position reviews clinical documentation, evaluates medical necessity and level-of-care determinations, applies ASAM Criteria and other applicable clinical standards, and presents clinical rationale supporting treatment recommendations and authorization requests. The Specialist works collaboratively with providers and clinical leadership to obtain supporting documentation and advocates for medically necessary care during payer reviews.

In addition to peer-to-peer representation, this role is responsible for monitoring authorization approvals, denials, and peer-to-peer outcomes to identify trends, support clinical performance improvement initiatives, and strengthen organizational understanding of payer expectations.

This is a clinical utilization management position and does not include responsibility for authorization submission, billing, claims processing, reimbursement, or other Revenue Cycle Management functions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Clinical Review and Peer-to-Peer Representation

• Serve as the organization's primary clinical representative during peer-to-peer reviews with payer representatives.

• Review clinical records and supporting documentation to prepare for peer-to-peer discussions.

• Evaluate clinical information to determine evidence supporting: Medical necessity Appropriate level of care Continued stay criteria Applicable payer requirements

• Apply ASAM Criteria and other relevant clinical standards when evaluating and presenting cases.

• Collaborate with direct service providers and clinical leadership to obtain additional information needed to support payer reviews.

• Present concise, evidence-based clinical rationale supporting treatment recommendations and authorization requests.

• Respond effectively to clinical questions and concerns raised by payer representatives.

• Document peer-to-peer outcomes, payer feedback, and recommendations in accordance with organizational procedures.

• Communicate significant outcomes and trends to the Vice President of Clinical Services and relevant stakeholders.

• Participate in payer-requested chart reviews, case consultations, and other clinical review activities as needed.

Authorization and Outcome Monitoring

• Track authorization approvals, denials, peer-to-peer reviews, and review outcomes.

• Monitor whether payer determinations are upheld, modified, or overturned following peer-to-peer review.

• Analyze trends by payer, service line, level of care, and treatment location.

• Identify recurring clinical factors associated with denials and adverse determinations.

• Maintain accurate data regarding peer-to-peer activity and effectiveness.

• Prepare routine reports regarding: Authorization approval and denial trends Peer-to-peer volume and outcomes Common denial reasons Medical necessity concerns Documentation trends Opportunities for clinical improvement

• Escalate significant or recurring concerns that warrant additional review or intervention.

Clinical Performance Improvement

• Analyze authorization and peer-to-peer outcomes to identify opportunities to improve clinical performance.

• Identify documentation and practice patterns that may negatively impact authorization decisions.

• Provide recommendations to clinical leadership related to: Medical necessity documentation ASAM application Level-of-care decisions Continued-stay justification Clinical documentation standards Responses to common payer concerns

• Provide targeted feedback to clinical leaders regarding identified trends.

• Assist in educating staff regarding recurring documentation and medical necessity concerns.

• Support development of clinical tools, guidance documents, and educational resources.

• Participate in utilization review meetings, case consultations, and quality improvement initiatives.

Collaboration and Clinical Consultation

• Collaborate with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) regarding denials and cases requiring peer-to-peer review.

• Communicate payer review outcomes that impact authorization decisions.

• Partner with providers and clinical leadership to gather necessary documentation and clinical information.

• Serve as an internal resource regarding payer expectations, medical necessity determinations, and denial trends.

• Participate in interdisciplinary meetings and special projects as requested.

• Perform other duties assigned by the Vice President of Clinical Services.

Required Qualifications

• Master's degree in Social Work, Counseling, Behavioral Health, or related clinical field.

• Active and unrestricted Ohio independent behavioral health license: Licensed Independent Social Worker (LISW) Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)

• Minimum of three (3) years of behavioral health clinical experience.

• Strong knowledge of ASAM Criteria and level-of-care decision making.

• Ability to assess medical necessity and interpret complex clinical information.

• Strong clinical judgment and critical-thinking skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to present clinical information effectively in professional discussions with payer representatives.

• Experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting clinical performance data.

• Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with clinical teams and external stakeholders.

• Successful completion of required background screening, compliance requirements, and drug screening.

Preferred Qualifications

• LISW-S or LPCC-S designation.

• Experience conducting peer-to-peer reviews.

• Prior utilization management, utilization review, or managed care experience.

• Experience working with Medicaid Managed Care Organizations, Medicare, and commercial insurance plans.

• Knowledge of payer medical necessity criteria and authorization processes.

• Experience analyzing denial trends and utilization management outcomes.

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.description:
About 8Fleet:

8Fleet is hiring. 8Fleet is a rapidly growing LA based technology and logistics startup building the operational infrastructure for both autonomous and non autonomous rideshare fleets. With our anticipated growth, we're searching for a Senior Manager, Safety, Risk & Compliance to protect our expanding W-2 driver workforce and build safety and risk programs that scale with us.

About the Role:

Reports To: Head of People

Location: Los Angeles, CA

The Senior Manager, Safety, Risk & Compliance leads 8Fleet's environmental, health, safety, workers' compensation, injury management, and risk compliance programs across our high-volume W-2 driver workforce and operating locations.

This role partners closely with People, Operations, Fleet, Legal, and external vendors to reduce workplace and driving-related risk, ensure regulatory compliance, manage employee injuries and claims, and build scalable safety programs as 8Fleet grows into new markets.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Safety & Risk Management: Own company-wide driver and workplace safety programs, policies, training, audits, and risk-reduction initiatives across all operating locations.

 - Workers' Compensation & Injury Management: Lead the workers' compensation and employee injury process, including injury reporting, claims oversight, investigations, return-to-work programs, accommodations, and coordination with employees, managers, and external partners.

 - Incident & Accident Management: Oversee workplace injuries, vehicle accidents, safety incidents, and near misses; conduct root-cause analysis and partner with Operations on corrective and preventive actions.

 - Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, Cal/OSHA, and other federal, state, and local workplace safety requirements, including required programs, training, documentation, reporting, and recordkeeping.

 - Background Checks & Drug and Alcohol Screening: Own pre-employment and ongoing background check and drug and alcohol screening programs for the driver workforce. Manage screening vendors and turnaround times, maintain consistent adjudication criteria and escalation paths, and ensure compliance with FCRA, state and local fair chance requirements, and applicable DOT and non-DOT testing protocols, including post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return-to-duty testing.

 - Driver Safety: Partner with Operations and Fleet leadership to identify driver safety trends, reduce preventable accidents and injuries, and establish consistent safety expectations across the driver workforce.

 - Vendor Management: Manage relationships and performance for workers' compensation, occupational health, safety, screening, claims, and other risk-related vendors. Ensure vendors meet service expectations, compliance requirements, and business needs.

 - New Market Launches: Lead safety, screening, and risk compliance readiness for new operating locations, ensuring required programs, training, vendors, processes, and controls are established prior to launch.

 - Metrics & Reporting: Monitor key safety and risk indicators, including workplace injuries, workers' compensation claims, vehicle incidents, lost-time injuries, screening and background check throughput, training completion, and corrective actions. Provide leadership with regular reporting on trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Successful Candidates Will Bring:

 - 10+ years of experience in Environmental Health & Safety, Risk Management, Workers' Compensation, Transportation Safety, or related fields.

 - Experience supporting a large hourly, driver, logistics, transportation, or multi-site workforce strongly preferred.

 - Strong knowledge of OSHA/Cal-OSHA, workers' compensation, injury management, and workplace safety requirements.

 - Experience managing workers' compensation claims, employee injuries, return-to-work programs, and external vendors.

 - Experience administering background check and drug and alcohol screening programs, including FCRA, fair chance, and DOT or non-DOT testing requirements.

 - Strong incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and risk-reduction experience.

 - Ability to build scalable programs and processes in a fast-paced, growing organization.

 - Strong communication and partnership skills across frontline employees, operational leaders, vendors, and senior leadership.

Base Salary Range: $130,000–$140,000

jobs.title: Webflow Designer (Contractor)
jobs.description:
About Broccoli 🥦

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.



The Role

Broccoli is looking for a Webflow Designer to help design and build our company website. You'll bring clean, modern design sense and strong Webflow skills to the project, helping shape how our site looks, functions, and grows over time. It's a great fit for someone who has a good eye for design, moves efficiently, and takes pride in producing polished, professional work.



What You'll Do

 - Take the lead on our website inside Webflow — from how pages are structured to how the CMS is organized behind the scenes

 - Make the visual calls: type, spacing, hierarchy, and how the brand comes across on the page

 - Set up reusable design components so new pages stay consistent with the rest of the site as we grow

 - Turn our ideas for campaigns, launches, and promotions into landing pages that look sharp and actually convert

 - Keep the site fast, responsive, and accessible without cutting corners on how it looks

jobs.description:
Fairstead is a purpose-driven real estate firm dedicated to building affordable communities across the country. Headquartered in New York, with offices in Colorado, Florida, and Washington DC, Fairstead owns and manages a portfolio of more than 30,000 apartments, including pipeline, across 28 states. As an integrated owner, operator, and innovator, Fairstead brings development, construction, and property management under one unified platform to deliver high-quality affordable housing that serves our residents at scale.

At Fairstead, we believe affordable housing should be thoughtfully designed, professionally managed, and responsibly operated. We seek to create and preserve housing that serves residents while delivering long-term value to communities, partners, and stakeholders.

Fairstead challenges industry norms through our tech-forward, entrepreneurial approach to affordable housing. In addition to core real estate capabilities, we operate innovative service lines designed to improve resident outcomes, strengthen communities, and drive operational efficiency. We embrace digital transformation, data-driven decision-making, and emerging technologies, including AI, to build scalable systems that support sustainable growth, grounded in a culture of entrepreneurship, innovation, partnership, dedication, and integrity.

Fairstead is seeking a Senior Litigation Attorney to join our in-house legal team. This role will manage a broad and varied docket of commercial, corporate, and employment litigation and dispute resolution matters arising across the firm's businesses. The ideal candidate is a seasoned commercial litigator who has handled complex, high-stakes matters in the New York State Supreme Court (including the Commercial Division), the Delaware Court of Chancery and Superior Court, federal court, and arbitration, and who is equally comfortable running the regulatory, investigative, employment, and routine commercial matters that come with a large operating platform. This is a hands-on role for someone who can carry many matters at once and serve as both a strategic advisor and an advocate.

Responsibilities:

• Oversee and have primary responsibility for all phases of litigation, arbitration, and regulatory proceedings, including pre-suit strategy, pleadings, discovery, motions practice, hearings, trial, and appeals

• Manage outside counsel on complex matters, including supervising strategy, reviewing work product, and controlling legal spend

• Handle or oversee a wide range of disputes, including:

• Complex commercial and corporate: contract disputes, business torts and fraud claims, partnership, LLC, and joint venture disputes, breach of fiduciary duty and books-and-records demands, governance and control disputes, advancement and indemnification, lender/borrower and guaranty disputes, and post-closing purchase price, earn-out, and indemnity claims

• Employment and HR: discrimination, harassment, retaliation, wrongful termination, wage and hour, restrictive covenant, and executive separation matters, including administrative charges and agency proceedings (EEOC, NYSDHR, NYCCHR, DOL)

• Routine commercial disputes: vendor, supplier, and service provider claims, collections, insurance coverage and tenders, subrogation, and pre-litigation demands and settlements

• Regulatory, investigative, and administrative: federal, state, and local agency investigations and enforcement proceedings, attorney general inquiries, subpoenas and civil investigative demands, licensing and permitting disputes, audits and examinations, and compliance-related claims

• Respond to government and regulatory inquiries, including managing document productions, witness preparation, internal investigations, and negotiated resolutions with agencies

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for business teams, HR, compliance, and finance on threatened and pending disputes, and resolve routine matters directly without outside counsel where appropriate

• Work with compliance and business teams to convert regulatory findings and litigation outcomes into policy and process fixes

• Brief senior leadership and board members on material litigation matters

• Manage litigation holds, preservation obligations, and the company's discovery and e-discovery processes

• Assist with contract drafting and negotiation across business lines to minimize future dispute risk

• Partner with business teams early in transactions, hiring decisions, and project planning to identify and mitigate litigation exposure across the firm's operations

• Help build and refine litigation management systems, including matter tracking, budget forecasting, and reporting

Requirements:

• J.D. from an accredited law school

• Active bar membership in NY; admission or ability to waive into additional jurisdictions preferred

• 15+ years of complex commercial and corporate litigation experience

• Substantial first-chair or lead-role experience in the New York State Supreme Court (including the Commercial Division), the Delaware Court of Chancery and Superior Court, comparable complex commercial courts in other jurisdictions, federal district court, and arbitration (AAA, JAMS)

• Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of simultaneous matters across subject areas - from significant commercial and corporate disputes to routine HR and vendor matters - without losing control of deadlines, budgets, or strategy

• Experience handling government and regulatory matters, including investigations, subpoenas and civil investigative demands, enforcement actions, and administrative proceedings

• Proven track record taking cases through trial, arbitration, or dispositive resolution

• Experience supervising outside counsel and managing litigation budgets

• Willingness and ability to handle routine employment and commercial disputes personally, not solely through outside counsel

• Strong drafting, negotiation, and oral advocacy skills

• Sound business judgment and a practical, risk-calibrated approach to dispute resolution

Preferred

• Prior in-house experience at an operating company or similarly complex organization

• Service as a partner or of counsel at a law firm, with demonstrated ownership of client relationships and a portfolio of matters

• Experience with Delaware corporate and alternative entity litigation, including fiduciary duty, Section 220, and advancement and indemnification proceedings

• Depth in employment litigation and HR-adjacent counseling and investigations

• Experience with regulated industries and with attorney general, agency, or other governmental enforcement matters

• Experience with alternative dispute resolution (mediation, arbitration)

• Familiarity with insurance coverage, tenders, and working with carrier-appointed counsel

• Exposure to real estate, construction, or housing-sector disputes is welcome but not required

Diversity in backgrounds and experiences is key to Fairstead’s success. Being an equal opportunity employer is a central tenet of our philosophy that shapes who we are and the communities we serve. Our goal is to ensure competitive total compensation that is commensurate with experience, location, and other market benchmarks.

https://fairstead.com/privacy-policy/
