jobs.title: Staff Electrical Superintendent
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

How You Will Make an Impact:

The Staff Electrical Superintendent carries two roles. It is the senior construction leader for electrical scope on Atlas power projects, providing oversight of electrical and mechanical contractors through installation, commissioning, and turnover. It is also the senior electrical leader supporting Atlas Field Operations, serving as the technical authority and escalation point for the operating fleet, setting electrical work practice and safety expectations in the field, and building the electrical capability of field personnel. This is a highly technical craft and construction leadership role rather than a design engineering role, though it supports the electrical engineering team with constructability input and field-driven design feedback.

Responsibilities

• Provide construction oversight of electrical and mechanical contractors, including work planning, sequencing, quality, and adherence to issued-for-construction documents.

• Serve as the senior electrical leader for Atlas Field Operations, providing technical authority, escalation support, and day to day guidance to field teams across the operating fleet.

• Act as the electrical escalation point for operating sites, including outage support, repair planning, and resolution of recurring electrical failures after turnover.

• Establish and reinforce electrical work practice, installation standards, and qualification expectations for Atlas field personnel and contract crews.

• Develop field procedures, job aids, and troubleshooting guides that raise the electrical capability of Field Operations.

• Train and coach field technicians and operations personnel on electrical systems, generation equipment, safe work practice, and diagnostic methods.

• Partner with Field Operations leadership on staffing capability, tooling and test equipment needs, and readiness for new site startups.

• Oversee installation of low and medium voltage power cabling, terminations, cable tray systems, conduit, and grounding systems for compliance with drawings, specifications, and NFPA 70 (NEC).

• Verify cable sizing, routing, tray fill, bending radius, support, and separation in the field against the released design and raise discrepancies to engineering.

• Oversee mechanical and piping installation scope where it interfaces with electrical systems, including engine, fuel, cooling, and exhaust piping.

• Lead site commissioning, functional testing, and startup activities for generation and power distribution equipment.

• Lead field troubleshooting and root cause resolution for electrical, generator, and controls issues during construction, commissioning, and early operation.

• Oversee installation, alignment, interconnection, and startup support for engine-driven generation, including 22L Doosan engines and associated alternators.

• Conduct installation quality inspections, punch list development, and closeout verification prior to turnover.

• Enforce electrical safety practice on site, including energized work controls, lockout tagout, arc flash boundaries, and applicable NFPA 70E requirements.

• Coordinate with contractors, vendors, EPC partners, and utilities on installation sequencing, inspections, and interconnection activities.

• Support the electrical design process with Atlas electrical engineers by providing constructability review, installation methods input, and field feedback on released designs.

• Perform drafting and redlines on construction drawings as required, and drive as-built documentation back to engineering for incorporation.

• Review contractor submittals, method statements, and installation plans for technical adequacy.

• Support material take-offs, installation estimates, and schedule input for electrical scope.

• Mentor field personnel and less experienced site staff on installation standards, commissioning practice, and troubleshooting methods.

• Advise engineering and project leadership on field risk, installation constraints, and lessons learned that should change standards or designs.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Required:

• High school diploma or equivalent is required.

• An engineering degree is preferred. Equivalent directly related experience in electrical construction, installation, and commissioning will be considered in lieu of a degree.

• 10-15+ years of experience in electrical construction, installation, or commissioning of industrial or power generation systems.

• Demonstrated leadership of electrical and mechanical contractors on active construction sites.

• Demonstrated experience serving as an electrical technical authority to field operations or maintenance organizations, including escalation support and troubleshooting of operating equipment.

• Demonstrated experience with low and medium voltage power cabling installation, terminations, cable tray systems, and grounding installation.

• Demonstrated experience with cable sizing and the ability to verify installed work against design documents.

• Demonstrated experience with engine-driven generation, including engine and alternator installation, interconnection, and startup support.

• Demonstrated experience leading commissioning, functional testing, and startup activities.

• Proven capability in field troubleshooting and root cause resolution of electrical and generation system issues.

• Working knowledge of piping installation as it interfaces with engine and power generation systems.

• Working knowledge of NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 70E, and applicable installation and safety standards.

• Ability to read, interpret, and redline construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and specifications.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with contractors, field crews, engineering, and project leadership.

• Valid Driver’s License and qualified through our company insurance/Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Policy

Preferred:

• Master Electrician License, active.

• Journeyman Electrician License with progress toward Master Electrician License.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, or a related field.

• Experience with 22L Doosan engines or comparable industrial engine platforms.

• Experience with medium voltage terminations, cable testing, and commissioning test equipment.

• Experience with microgrid, distributed generation, or modular power plant construction.

• Experience supporting utility interconnection and coordinating with authorities having jurisdiction.

• Proficiency with AutoCAD for redlines and construction markups.

• OSHA 30, NFPA 70E, or equivalent site safety certifications.

Reporting Relationship:

Reports To: Director of Electrical Engineering

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility but may provide mentorship, guidance, training, or work direction to others

Work Location & Travel Requirements

Location: Midland, TX or Carlsbad, NM

Work Environment: Field, Construction Sites, Shop, Outdoors, Office

Travel %: 50%

Schedule/Work Arrangement: Field based out of Midland, TX or Carlsbad, NM; Monday through Friday, standard business hours, with schedule flexibility to support active construction, commissioning, and startup windows.

Physical Demands:

• Must be able to lift and carry materials, tools, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis.

• Position requires sustained presence on active construction and commissioning sites, including areas with uneven surfaces, energized equipment, moving equipment, and potential exposure to slips, trips, falls, noise, dust, and other common site hazards.

• Must be able to walk job sites, climb stairs and ladders, work at elevation, enter equipment enclosures, and stand for extended periods.

• Must be able to bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and work in confined or restricted spaces while complying with all applicable safety requirements.

• Must be able to work outdoors in variable weather conditions, including extreme heat and cold.

• Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment, including arc-rated clothing, for extended periods.

• Must be able to travel by air and vehicle to project sites for extended periods, including regular travel across the Permian Basin.

What You Will Love About Us

Best People and Team. Great Place to Work, Hire Vets, Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman

Your Well-Being is a Priority. 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision

Invest in Your Future. 401K with company match, immediate vesting

Relax and Recharge. Paid time off (non-rotational roles), 15+ company paid holidays

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Atlas Energy Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Reasonable Accommodation

Atlas Energy Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and those with pregnancy-related conditions in accordance with applicable law.

Job Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified at any time based on business needs.

• The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Tax Account Registration Specialist
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, detail-oriented professional who brings structure to complexity. You excel at identifying opportunities to streamline processes and consistently drive toward greater efficiency through a mix of subject matter expertise and tech fluency. As the Tax Account Registration Specialist, you own the end-to-end health of our customers' tax profiles. You are a research-driven self-starter who loves breaking down complicated concepts into simple terms and solving problems with an automation-forward mindset.

The Tax Account Registration Specialist, is responsible for the complete lifecycle management of tax registrations and third-party access (TPA) for our customers. This role involves cross-functional collaboration with the Onboarding, Payroll Tax Operation, Payroll Tax Notice and Customer Success Organization teams to gather necessary information, ensuring successful relationships with all stakeholders. A crucial function of this position is State Agency relationship management. The Specialist will combine operational expertise and problem-solving skills to efficiently resolve inquiries and issues while ensuring every tax profile is accurate, compliant, and prepared for seamless filing.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

• Own the end-to-end tax registration process for new and existing customers expanding into new states. This includes:

• Completing and filing all necessary Power of Attorney forms.

• End-to-end implementation of new customer profiles, including registering accounts for state-level unemployment, withholding tax, paid family and medical leave, and worker’s compensation agencies, as well as all applicable local-level wage and business taxes.

• Partner with state agency representatives to ensure proper account setup.

• Execute and complete TPA confirmation workflows, ensuring Justworks is properly linked to customer accounts for all required state agencies.

• Manage the queue of open issues to deliver timely and effective solutions regarding a customer's unemployment tax account.

• Collect and disperse registration confirmations, tax rates, and account IDs internally across systems, teams, and workflows to ensure tax filing readiness.

• Daily responsibilities include accurately inputting new customer and relevant tax data into the tax reporting and filing software, confirming its accuracy, and escalating any issues to senior team.

• Craft outbound emails to customers regarding required account information, following up via phone as needed to meet service level agreements (SLAs).

• Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual tasks, establishing new standard operating procedures to maximize efficiency.

• Contribute recommendations for improving the collection and tax remittance process as applicable.

• Act as a research owner by staying informed on state regulations affecting new registrations and documenting state-specific requirements to maintain compliance.

• Update state requirements and setup instructions as changes occur, ensuring all information is current, streamlined, and easy to follow.

• Remain informed regarding state regulations affecting new business registrations and account maintenance.

• Track trends identified within each state and proactively develop relevant responses.

• Conduct regular audits of account data and Third-Party Administrator (TPA) connections to identify unfiled returns or outstanding penalties before filing deadlines.

• Partner with Onboarding, Customer Success, and Payroll Tax Filing teams to resolve complex inquiries and integrate regulatory changes into documentation.

• Partner with the State unemployment claims team to ensure timely account updates for correct claim routing.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Tax Account Registration Specialist, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

• Detail-oriented: Bring rigor and precision to your work, seeking to understand both the cause and effect of every tax profile update.

• Systems Thinking: Recognize how people, processes, and timelines interact, using that understanding to optimize how registrations impact the larger tax supply chain.

• Solution-oriented: Identify the source of a challenge and provide a better, more automated way of doing things.

• Consultative Communication: Build strong relationships by asking open-ended questions and actively listening to understand customer and internal stakeholder needs, allowing you to translate complex state requirements into simple, actionable, and tailored solutions.

• Grit & Integrity: Dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude and always match your words with your actions.

• Taking responsibility: Accountable, being committed, and accepting ownership for one's decisions, actions, and behavior.

• Adaptability: Adjust your approach or actions in response to changes in your external environment.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Exercises critical thinking to analyze, assess, and solve problems; identifies patterns and underlying issues; connects concepts; understands risks and develops mitigation strategies; and takes ownership of outcomes.

• Curious: the innate desire to learn, grow, understand and innovate.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

 - 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans. 

 - 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

 - Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

 - 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan 

 - Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

 - $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

 - Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

 - Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

 - Company paid Wellable subscription
   
   

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A to help build the planning and analysis engine of a high-growth AI infrastructure company in hyper-growth mode. This is a generalist seat with unusual breadth: you will work across the full three-statement model supporting long-range planning, budgeting, forecasting, and executive / Board reporting. The role will work directly with the Head of FP&A and CFO, and be involved in contract-level deal economics, and high-impact analytical workstreams.



Key Responsibilities

 - Build and maintain driver-based three-statement financial models: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow - supporting the long-range plan, annual budget, and rolling forecast.

 - Manage internally owned long-range planning model: document assumptions, build scenario and sensitivity capability (base / upside / downside), and roll the model forward each cycle.

 - Own workstreams within the monthly forecast and close cadence: consolidate revenue, opex, headcount, and capex inputs; reconcile to general ledger actuals; and produce variance analysis with root-cause explanations for material movements.

 - Model contract-level economics across the business: revenue ramp schedules and deployment timing, as well as capital-side analysis including unit economics, payback, IRR, and debt service coverage on infrastructure deployments.

 - Analyze complex infrastructure contract structures: revenue share agreements, capacity backstops, residual value guarantees, and customer prepayments - ensuring accurate revenue timing, margin, and cash forecasting.

 - Prepare management, board, and lender-facing reporting: budget-vs-actual bridges, KPI packages, and supporting analysis for executive decision-making.

 - Build scenario tooling across the plan: deployment slips, contract roll-off and renewals, pricing sensitivity, and capital deployment alternatives.

 - Support ad hoc strategic and transaction analysis, including debt and equity financing processes, deal evaluation, and corporate development workstreams.

 

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience in investment banking, FP&A, corporate development, or a comparable role with direct ownership of three-statement financial models.

 - Demonstrated analytical rigor: you can decompose a variance to its driver, quantify forward impact, and communicate findings clearly to senior leadership.

 - Comfort extracting economic terms directly from contracts, order forms, and transaction documents.

 - Advanced proficiency in Excel financial modeling, including scenario and sensitivity architecture.

 - High ownership and pace: able to run multiple workstreams in a lean, fast-moving team with executive visibility.

 - Investment banking experience with exposure to infrastructure, data center, cloud or semiconductor industries is a plus.

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure business models, usage/consumption billing, or large-scale CapEx-intensive businesses .

 - SQL or comparable data extraction skills; NetSuite ERP / NSPB, Salesforce, and Google Workspace proficiency.

 

Compensation

$125,000 - $135,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. 

 


INCLUSION & PRIVACY

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy https://www.vultr.com/legal/privacy/.

jobs.title: Medical Review Nurse
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION: HOSPITAL-QUALITY CARE, EVERYWHERE.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!




OUR VALUES: THE PRINCIPLES THAT GUIDE US

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

 - We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.

 - We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.

 - We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.

 - We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.
   
   

About the Role 

This isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to build something that truly matters and directly shape the future of at-home care. As our Medical Reviewer, you will play a critical, hands-on role in ensuring that every durable medical equipment (DME) order is fully compliant with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) regulations, including Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and Local Coverage Articles (LCAs)  You will serve as the bridge between complex policy requirements and operational excellence, directly safeguarding our compliance integrity and billing quality.

Key Responsibilities

 - Medical Necessity & Compliance Review: Review  DMEPOS orders, progress notes, and medical records against coverage policies to confirm medical necessity across diverse DME categories (e.g., Surgical Dressings, CGMs, Insulin Pumps, Wound Care, Ostomy, Urology, CPAP/PAP therapy, Ventilators, Wheelchairs, etc.).

 - Provider Education: Communicate findings clearly with healthcare providers and internal teams to bridge documentation gaps and educate stakeholders on evolving coverage criteria.

 - Data Security: Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA and enforce disciplined handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) across all workflows.

Required Qualifications

 - Prior experience (3 - 5+ years) with DME pre-authorizations, DME utilization management reviews and/or DME claim audit processes.

 - Standard computer literacy and proficiency with medical review software/EHR platforms.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex policy requirements clearly.

 - Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a flexible, adaptable mindset.

 - Strong team player with a highly collaborative work style.

 - Strict adherence to PHI guidelines and patient privacy protocols.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with InterQual and/or MCG review criteria.

 - Experience in reviewing specific DME claims, including Surgical Dressings, CGMs, Insulin Pumps, Wound Care, Ostomy, Urology, CPAP/PAP therapy.




OUR PLEDGE FOR AN EQUITABLE FUTURE

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

Identifier rapidement les risques et les opportunités d'affaires et prendre des mesures correctives pour optimiser les résultats.
Favoriser une culture d’imputabilité, de rigueur commerciale et d'amélioration continue.



Indicateurs de succès : Revenus par rapport au budget; BAIIA par rapport au budget; Précision des prévisions; Amélioration des marges; Performance des flux de trésorerie.


Croissance commerciale et optimisation des revenus
Stimuler une croissance durable des revenus provenant de la vente de billets, des expériences premium, des commandites, des produits dérivés, de la restauration et des autres sources de revenus accessoires.
Assumer la responsabilité de l'optimisation des revenus locaux, notamment la tarification, le rendement, l'inventaire, la stratégie des produits premium et la génération de la demande, en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales centralisées.
Utiliser les analyses de marché, l'intelligence d'affaires et les données clients pour éclairer les décisions et maximiser la rentabilité.
Renforcer la position du spectacle sur le marché grâce à des partenariats commerciaux stratégiques et à des initiatives de développement des affaires.



Indicateurs de succès : Croissance des revenus; Achalandage et taux d'occupation; Rendement des revenus; Dépenses des clients; Part de marché.


Expérience client et excellence de la marque
Assurer une expérience client de calibre mondial qui rehausse davantage la marque Cirque du Soleil.
Collaborer avec l'ensemble des fonctions pour améliorer le parcours client, accroître la satisfaction de la clientèle et fidéliser les visiteurs.
Utiliser une communication proactive, la narration et des activations de marché pour attirer de nouveaux publics, créer un engouement et positionner le spectacle comme l'expérience de divertissement incontournable de son marché.
Équilibrer la performance commerciale avec l'intégrité artistique, la fiabilité opérationnelle et les normes premium de la marque.



Indicateurs de succès : Satisfaction de la clientèle; Indice NPS; Fidélisation des visiteurs; Croissance des revenus premium; Atteinte des indicateurs liés à l'expérience; Croissance de l'auditoire et visibilité sur le marché.


Leadership des personnes et exécution transversale
Bâtir une culture de haute performance ancrée dans la responsabilisation, la collaboration, l'innovation et les valeurs de Cirque du Soleil.
Développer les capacités de leadership et les bassins de relève au sein de l'organisation du spectacle.
Aligner les centres d'expertise sur les priorités du spectacle et tenir les leaders fonctionnels responsables des résultats convenus.
Exercer un leadership efficace par l'influence dans un environnement matriciel.

Assurer des opérations de spectacle sécuritaires, efficaces et fiables.
Promouvoir l'innovation, l'adoption de nouvelles technologies et les initiatives d'amélioration des processus qui renforcent la rentabilité et l'expérience client.
Repérer et atténuer les risques opérationnels, commerciaux, liés aux talents, à la réputation et à la réglementation.
Maintenir des pratiques rigoureuses de conformité, de gouvernance et de continuité des affaires.



Indicateurs de succès : Performance en matière de sécurité; Atteinte des indicateurs opérationnels; Préparation à la continuité des affaires; Amélioration de la productivité; Efficacité de l'atténuation des risques.

jobs.title: Clinical Account Executive - Oncology - San Diego, CA
jobs.description:
This role is field-based and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city. This geography covers San Diego, Chula Vista, El Cajon, Escondido, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Temecula, Mission Viejo, CA and the surrounding areas.​

Reporting to the Senior District Manager, the Clinical Account Executive (CAE) serves as the strategic leader of their territory. They combine deep clinical expertise, strategic account planning, business acumen, and purposeful execution to improve patient outcomes, advance the organization’s mission, and support the brand objectives and business goals of the CLL and NHL Oncology Products. A CAE must be able to build trusted partnerships with customers, think like business owners, and collaborate across the oncology ecosystem to create long-term value for patients, customers, and the organization - which includes but is not limited to,  responsible resource allocation, a commitment to operating principles and compliant, high ethical standards.

Key Accountabilities/Core Job Responsibilities:

• SALES EXPERIENCE: Demonstrated history of delivering exceptional results through disciplined execution, accountability, and ownership. Preference for Oncology/Hematology experience
• BUSINESS ACUMEN: Thinks strategically about customers, key accounts, and market dynamics to prioritize opportunities and maximize sustainable business impact across in-field teams
• PURPOSEFUL EXECUTION: Consistently translates strategy into focused action, balancing urgency with discipline while executing with precision
• LEARNING AGILITY: Rapidly learns complex scientific, clinical, and business concepts and confidently applies them in dynamic customer environments
• COMMUNICATION: Simplifies complex clinical and business concepts into clear, compelling points
• RESILIENCE: Demonstrates grit, adaptability, and persistence while maintaining a positive, solutions-oriented approach in a competitive environment
• INTELLECTUAL CURIOSITY: Naturally seeks to understand the science, the customer, and the business beyond what is required
• Develop and execute a comprehensive territory business plan aligned with brand strategy and local customer needs.
• Build trusted relationships with hematologists, oncologists, nurses, pharmacists, administrators, and key account stakeholders.
• Demonstrate deep scientific and clinical expertise while delivering compliant, customer-focused engagements.
• Partner effectively with cross-functional colleagues to deliver coordinated customer experiences.
• Continuously evaluate territory performance using data, customer insights, and business analytics to optimize execution.
• Maintain the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and professionalism in every customer interaction.
• Complete all AbbVie required training and maintain adherence to all company policies and OEC/Legal procedures
• Continuously develop clinical, business, and leadership capabilities
• An essential requirement of the position is to meet health care industry representative credentialing requirements to gain entry into facilities and organizations that are in assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.

• 5+ years sales experience in pharma/biotech, medical device, or diagnostics
• Desire and ability to take on larger roles faster than their peers
• Competitive selling skills
• Demonstrated ability to work within a highly collaborative, team environment.
• Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Persistency and grit with strong track record of succeeding in a challenging environment
• Driving a personal auto or company car or truck.
• Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.
• Business travel, by air or car, is regularly required

Preferred:

• Oncology experience, preferably in hematologic malignancies
• Bachelor’s degree preferred
• Account Management experience in any industry
• Specialty Pharmacy experience
• Healthcare industry experience, especially working with patients or consulting healthcare companies
• People management or other leadership experience
• MBA or other advanced degree

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Enterprise Product
jobs.description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, the Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for the systems at the core of how teams, venues, and promoters manage tickets and operate their businesses. Hundreds of major live event venues around the globe rely on the SeatGeek platform, including those home to the Dallas Cowboys, Cleveland Cavaliers, Florida Panthers, and Manchester United F.C.

You will set technical direction for this complex, mature platform while helping lead its evolution toward SeatGeek’s next generation of products and architecture. At the same time, you will help change how we build software as we move toward an AI-native engineering organization.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between technology, product, and the ticketing domain. You will partner closely with Product and Design leadership, Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, and our clients to turn complicated business problems into clear technical and product direction.

What you'll do

• Set technical direction across US Ticketing, working with Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers on architecture, system ownership, modernization, and platform boundaries

• Lead the evolution of a mature, business-critical platform, balancing client commitments and near-term delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, and modernization

• Stay close to the technology and contribute directly when useful, whether through code, prototypes, debugging, architecture reviews, technical designs, or documentation

• Pioneering AI-native engineering by evolving how teams design, build, test, operate, and understand software, and by turning successful experiments into repeatable improvements

• Partner as a peer with Product and Design leadership to shape strategy, not simply execute a roadmap

• Develop a deep understanding of our clients and business, distinguish client-specific needs from durable platform opportunities, and participate directly in important client, sales, and implementation conversations when engineering context matters

• Lead and develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, creating clear ownership and strong leverage through others

• Build a strong engineering organization by developing leaders, growing Staff+ talent, and evolving team structure as the business changes

• Create an engineering culture that combines high ownership, healthy technical debate, strong execution, and sustainable performance

What you have

• Experience leading multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers in a complex software organization

• Strong technical judgment and enough architectural depth to work credibly with senior engineers on difficult system and platform decisions

• A willingness and ability to contribute technically when it is the highest-leverage way to help, including architecture, technical writing, prototyping, debugging, and code

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development and a strong point of view on how AI changes engineering practices and the software development lifecycle

• Experience evolving mature, business-critical systems while continuing to deliver customer value

• A track record of creating technical strategy from ambiguous product and business problems

• Experience partnering closely with senior Product and Design leaders and learning complex customer domains quickly

• Experience developing Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers and creating leverage through other leaders

• Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, ownership, and comfort making consequential decisions with incomplete information

• Experience with ticketing, live events, commerce, payments, reservations, inventory, or similarly complex transactional systems is a plus

Our stack

US Ticketing includes mature systems that have powered some of the world’s largest live events for years alongside newer services and applications. We care much more about your ability to understand complex systems, make sound architectural decisions, lead modernization, and use new tools effectively than experience with any particular language or framework.

This is a deeply technical leadership role. We do not expect the Director to be the primary implementer, but we do expect them to be willing and able to contribute technically when it helps move the team forward. AI is becoming a core part of our engineering process, and this leader will help us rethink how teams build and evolve software in an AI-native development environment.

Perks

• Equity stake

• Discretionary annual bonus

• Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely

• A WFH stipend to support your home office setup

• Unlimited PTO

• Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave

• 401(k) matching

• Student loan matching program

• Health, vision, dental, and life insurance

• Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care

• $500 per year for wellness expenses

• Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical

• $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events

• Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $236,000-$341,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings.

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Integration Systems Engineer, Edge Compute and Communications
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

OUR TEAM

Within Anduril, our team develops unmanned aerial systems capable of terminal guidance, long range intelligence collection, precision navigation, and unsupervised autonomy.  Anvil, Altius, Ghost, and other developmental UAS platforms operate in remote environments with limited user input, driving requirements for reliability and autonomy.  We have developed an autonomy stack that receives user intent, responds to detections processed at the edge, and coordinates flight patterns for groups of assets.  We want systems engineers with experience in this field to help design and manage the next generation of Anduril’s flight vehicles.  In order to succeed at Anduril, a systems engineer needs familiarity with simulation and rapid prototyping development to drive complex electro-mechanical and aero-performance design trades, in addition to supporting the engineering product development, production, and sustainment through the entire product lifecycle.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead development for an end-to-end solution by collaborating with cross-functional teams to define requirements and system architecture

• Design, develop, and maintain system components that meet functional and performance requirements in complex system environments

• Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the reliability, scalability, and resilience of software applications, especially within a distributed systems context

• Work closely with hardware engineers and product managers to ensure seamless integration of software and hardware components

• Collaborate with the team to define and document software engineering processes and practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A passion for systems design, development, integration, and testing

• 12+ years of industry experience including but not limited to electrical engineering, aerospace engineering or systems engineering

• Comfort with systems modeling tools such as Cameo

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to operate effectively in an Agile development environment

• Hands-on prototyping, troubleshooting, and build experience of complex robotic systems

• Experience developing automated test scripts and frameworks using a common language (eg, Python, MATLAB, etc)

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented, and excellent verbal & written communication skills

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture

• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

• Ability to travel domestically up to 25% as needed for test planning and execution, and excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA the rest of the time!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Hands-on experience with prototyping, troubleshooting, and building complex robotic systems

• Familiarity with IP- based networks

• Experience with mission systems to include communications systems and components

• Familiarity with aviation airworthiness considerations

• Already hold a U.S. Secret security clearance, or higher

US Salary Range

$200,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
People Business Partner, Operations,  People Team (Remote)

Full-Time, Remote / Salaried, Exempt

Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno was built on a simple idea - litigation support shouldn't be an obstacle. Since 2018, we've been delivering on that promise, growing into a business with over $90M raised, a team that continues to scale, and a multi-product platform serving thousands of law firms nationwide. We combine expert and hospitable services, proprietary data, and modern technology in a way no one else in the legal industry can.

Our Operations organization is the engine behind that promise - the team that gets depositions covered, transcripts delivered, and clients served on time, every time. This role sits on the People team as the dedicated People Business Partner to that organization, working at two altitudes at once — close enough to the front line to engage with individual contributors and coach managers through the day-to-day, and trusted enough by senior Operations leaders to be a real thought partner as their part of the business grows.

Who are you?

You're an HR Business Partner who's spent real time inside operational environments — places where the pace of the business and the people running it are tightly linked. You've coached frontline managers through hard conversations, and you've also earned the trust of senior leaders on tough people and team decisions. You're equally comfortable in both rooms.

You lead with strong HR Business Partner fundamentals — coaching, performance management, employee relations, workforce planning — and that foundation makes you a trusted advisor for leaders working through hard decisions about their team. You read people, people data, and organizational signals with equal fluency, and you use several inputs to stay ahead of problems.

You're comfortable being the connective layer between centrally designed people programs and the realities of a fast-moving business unit — translating strategy into something a frontline manager can actually use, while also being a real thought partner to senior leaders navigating tough calls. You know where your judgment ends and where something needs to be escalated, and you lead with what's effective, even when it isn't the popular call.

What you'll drive

• Partner with Operations leaders - from senior leadership to frontline managers — on workforce and organizational planning tied to production volume, client demand, and the pace of the business
• Coach managers, especially first-line and newer managers,on performance conversations and team dynamics, building their capability to handle these situations themselves
• Identify people risks inside Operations early - attrition patterns, capability gaps, engagement dips — by pairing data with what you're hearing directly from the people closest to the work
• Innovate centrally built people programs (performance cycles, comp changes, talent processes) to Operations' structure and calendar, and own execution on the ground
• Handle employee relations matters within Operations with appropriate discretion and sound judgment on what to resolve directly versus escalate
• Represent People, including recommended team and company procedures, at Operations' planning and leadership discussions as a standing partner
• Feed real signal from the field back to the People team so programs get built for how Operations actually works

You'll thrive here if

• You've spent 7+ years as an HR Business Partner, including meaningful time supporting an operational or frontline workforce
• You've directly supported a business unit through a period of significant growth and can speak to how you handled the people side of it
• You've coached managers through headcount planning, as well as performance and team issues, and can point to managers who got better because of you
• You shape strategic and tactical decisions with senior leaders as a genuine thought partner, bringing your own point of view to the table
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and can tell the difference between what needs your judgment or intervention now and what can wait
• You bring data into people conversations — attrition, engagement, staffing trends — alongside what you're hearing directly from the people closest to the work
• You build trust quickly with operational leaders at every level, from frontline managers to senior executives

Our Team

Operations is the largest team at Steno and the one clients feel most directly — Production, Billing, Provider Operations, Customer Success, and Scheduling all sit inside it. This role sits on the People team, reporting to the VP, People Business Partners & Operations, and partners closely with Operations leadership as the group scales.

Compensation & Benefits

• Salary - $130,000 - $160,000
• Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous, low-cost plans for employees and their families
• Wellness & Mental Health — shared benefits designed to support the whole person
• Flexible Paid Time Off — trust-based and meant to be used
• Equity options — so you share in what we're building
• Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
• Home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

• Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
• Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at accommodations@steno.com.
• Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.
• Applicants should receive a confirmation email immediately after applying. If you haven't received it, check your email spam folder and approve the sender address to ensure receipt of future communications.
• Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
• Steno uses AI-assisted tools to help review applications and identify candidates whose experience aligns with the role. All hiring decisions are made by our People team, and a member of our team will personally reach out to candidates selected to move forward in the process.

jobs.title: Factory Construction Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Factory Construction Intern, you’ll get hands-on experience bringing a factory to life - designing and standing up the processes that make our products real. You’ll work alongside engineers, operators, and builders in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, contributing to everything from facility layouts to construction progress tracking. This is a chance to learn by doing, where your work will directly shape how we deliver affordable energy at scale.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Support coordination between civil engineering team and manufacturing team to align facility design with production requirements.

 - Assist with reviewing interior build-out plans, MEP layouts, warehouse racking, and equipment move-in logistics to ensure efficient setup and compliance with requirements.

 - Participate in design and construction meetings, capturing action items and tracking progress on civil-related deliverables.

 - Contribute to quantity takeoffs, cost tracking, and documentation for civil works tied to the factory build.

 - Conduct field visits to observe construction activities, verify work against plans, and report findings to the project team.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage details across multiple stakeholders.

 - Interest in facility design, construction methods, and how they intersect with manufacturing operations.

 - Ability to read or interpret construction drawings, layouts, and technical documentation.

 - Eagerness to participate in fieldwork, site walks, and hands-on problem solving.

 - Analytical mindset for tracking costs, quantities, and progress against plans.

 - Clear communication skills for documenting action items and sharing findings with cross-functional teams.

 - Proactive, “learn by doing” attitude with willingness to dive into new technical areas.



About the Team

The Infrastructure & Development team builds and maintains the physical foundation that enables Base Power to operate and grow. We own the full lifecycle of capital projects—factory builds, manufacturing line installations, and headquarters—acting as the primary stewards of our physical footprint. We move fast, make decisions with confidence, and hold our design and construction partners to a high standard. Every project we deliver creates the physical conditions for Base Power to scale.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

 - 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans. 

 - 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

 - Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

 - 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan 

 - Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

 - $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

 - Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

 - Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a Senior Technical Support Engineer to join our Technical Support team and serve as the senior technical resource for Vultr’s strategic and VIP customers. In this role, you will act as the final technical escalation point for these accounts, taking ownership of the most complex issues across Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, and the wider enterprise stack, and driving them through resolution and root cause analysis. The ideal candidate combines senior Linux System Administer technical skill with customer facing Technical Support experience, willing to troubleshoot the most complex issues directly with our most demanding customers.

This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require a candidate that is technically driven, detail-oriented, and customer obsessed with strong communication skills. Outside of active escalations, you will focus on building the capability of the wider support organization writing advanced troubleshooting documentation, training Technical Support Engineers in advanced Linux and in the architectures of our strategic accounts, and developing depth in an assigned technical domain that you share with the rest of the Senior Technical Support Engineer team.

Key Responsibilities

 - Respond to customer inquiries and provide technical guidance regarding Vultr products and services, including complex or escalated issues.

 - Directly engage with strategic customers via email, Slack, Zoom, Google Meet, and other channels.

 - Develop and maintain deep expertise in an assigned technical domain — such as Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, distributed storage, virtualization, or enterprise networking — and transfer that expertise to fellow Senior Technical Support Engineers so the team carries redundant depth.

 - Train Technical Support Engineers in advanced Linux troubleshooting and in the architectures of Vultr’s strategic and VIP accounts.

 - Author and maintain advanced troubleshooting documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base content.

 - Support Customer Success Managers by preparing the technical inputs for quarterly business reviews, and attend QBRs to present and discuss that analysis.

 - Identify recurring issues and incident patterns across strategic accounts, and feed those insights to engineering and account teams to reduce repeat impact.

 - Serve as the terminal technical escalation point within Technical Support for strategic and VIP accounts, taking ownership of complex issues escalated by Technical Support Engineers, driving them to resolution.

 - Own the technical resolution of incidents affecting strategic and VIP customers, remaining owner through root cause analysis and preventative recommendation.

 - Troubleshoot complex, non-routine issues across the enterprise stack — Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, virtualization, storage, and networking.

 - Act as named technical lead for an assigned subset of strategic and VIP accounts, maintaining working knowledge of each customer’s environment and issue history to accelerate diagnosis, while sharing responsibility with the team for the full portfolio.

 - Engage directly with strategic customers via tickets, email, Slack, and video conference, and participate in retrospectives and live troubleshooting sessions.

 - Coordinate with system administration, engineering, networking, and data center teams to resolve platform-level problems and outages.

 - Provide coverage aligned to peak strategic and VIP activity across EMEA and US business hours, and serve as an out-of-hours callout resource on a rotating basis for incidents the on-shift team cannot resolve.

 - Participate in a 24/7 team-based operations environment, including scheduled shift coverage as determined by business needs.

 

Qualifications

 - Deep, demonstrated experience with Linux systems, including advanced command-line troubleshooting and investigation (4+ years)

 - Experience in enterprise technical support or a similar advanced support role, directly supporting enterprise or strategic customers in an infrastructure-as-a-service or cloud context (4+ years)

 - Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following, with the ability to teach it to peers and to build working competence in the others:

 - Kubernetes and container orchestration

 - GPU infrastructure and service delivery

 - Distributed storage

 - Virtualization technologies

 - Enterprise networking and load balancing

 - Solid grasp of troubleshooting methodologies and the ability to apply them to complex, non-routine issues

 - Experience mentoring, training, or otherwise developing the technical capability of other engineers

 - Strong English written and verbal communication, able to hold a technical conversation with anyone from an administrator to an executive sponsor in high-pressure situations

 - Ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced operations environment with out-of-hours callout responsibility

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong proficiency with the English language

Compensation

$90,000 - $110,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. 

 


INCLUSION & PRIVACY

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy https://www.vultr.com/legal/privacy/.

jobs.title: Scientist II, siRNA Screening Automation and Molecular Analytics
jobs.description:
AbbVie’s Biotherapeutic and Genetic Medicine (BGM) department is seeking a highly motivated Scientist to support the development and operation of a high-throughput siRNA screening platform. This role will focus on automation-enabled screening workflows and data analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with platform and program teams to build robust, scalable workflows that accelerate siRNA lead discovery and optimization across multiple therapeutic areas.

Responsibilities

• Lead execution of high-throughput siRNA screening workflows using automated liquid-handling and other laboratory automation systems.

• Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot automated methods for sample preparation workflows, including RNA extraction, RT-qPCR, and RNA-seq library preparation.

• Design and execute experiments to evaluate siRNA activity, potency, and selectivity using molecular biology assay platforms.

• Establish and maintain data analysis workflows for screening datasets, including assay QC, normalization, hit assessment, and interpretation of experimental results.

• Drive development and implementation of next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based strategies using automation for gene expression profiling.

• Partner with different groups, cross-functional scientists and bioinformatics, to support analysis and interpretation of large screening and sequencing datasets.

• Contribute to the improvement, standardization, and documentation of screening workflows, assay protocols, and automation procedures.

• Identify technical issues proactively and implement solutions to improve assay robustness, throughput, and reproducibility.

• Present results clearly to project teams and platform leadership, and contribute to scientific discussions, experimental planning, and strategy.

• Mentor junior scientists or research associates as needed and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing laboratory environment.

• BS or MS in Molecular Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Bioengineering, or a related discipline with typically 7+ years (BS) or 5+ years (MS) of relevant industry experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with laboratory automation, high-throughput screening workflows, and coding for automation systems.
• Deep experience with RNA extraction and RT-qPCR assay development, execution, and troubleshooting.
• Familiarity with NGS workflows for library construction and gene expression profiling, including integration of automation with NGS library preparation or other downstream molecular workflows.
• Experience with siRNA screening, oligonucleotide therapeutics, or RNA biology strongly preferred.
• Familiarity with scripting, data processing tools, or bioinformatics collaboration models.
• Prior experience supporting platform buildout in a matrixed drug discovery environment.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

By identifying technical and operational bottlenecks early, you ensure that platform updates and large-scale implementations move forward without friction or surprises.

 - Visibility & Communication: Provide clear, concise updates to leadership on program health, resource allocation, and core KPIs.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Experienced Program Leader: You have 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or a similar role.

 - Technically Fluent: You don't need to be an engineer, but you are comfortable in technical environments. You understand how APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure work together and can follow technical discussions with ease.

 - Expert Communicator: You excel at taking a complex technical update and distilling it into a clear status report for non-technical stakeholders.

 - Operational Mindset: You have a bias toward action. You enjoy building the "system for the work" so that everyone else can do their jobs effectively.

 - Collaborative & Resilient: You are a natural relationship builder who can influence teams without having direct authority over them. You stay calm under pressure and help teams navigate shifting priorities.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects from inception to launch.

 - Proficiency with project management tools (Jira, Linear, Asana etc.) and documentation software (Confluence, Notion).

 - Experience in a fast-paced SaaS environment is a major plus.

 - Strong analytical skills; you use data to drive decisions and measure project success.

Please note: we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, New York, or San Francisco). Our weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely.

jobs.title: Senior Front End Engineer
jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Overview

At PrizePicks, we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth — from our consumer-facing mobile app to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Checkout & Gameplay team and help us continue to build the future of fantasy sports.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript and React Native to join our Checkout & Gameplay team. In this role, you will design, build, and own critical features within PrizePicks’ React Native mobile application. You will tackle high-scope, complex technical problems, define the technical path from product idea to production, and mentor engineers across your team and the organization. This is a role for someone who thrives on crafting exceptional mobile experiences and wants to have a direct impact on a product used by millions.

What You’ll Do

• Design and build mobile features: Architect and implement complex features and interaction flows in our React Native app that are performant, accessible, and deliver exceptional user experiences.

• Own technical delivery: Lead the technical design and implementation of complex features end-to-end — from product requirements through deployment and monitoring.

• Drive app performance: Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, optimize rendering, reduce bundle size, and improve the overall responsiveness of the mobile app.

• Define technical direction: Propose and drive architectural decisions for your team’s mobile features, evaluating tradeoffs and communicating recommendations clearly.
